articleTitle: Green Coffee Bean Defect Detection Using Shift-Invariant Features and Non-Local Block
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: In recent years, markets targeting the production of coffee have been flourishing. In order to achieve and preserve higher-quality coffee beans, it is essential to detect defects before roasting them. However, the manual process often results in human errors due to fatigue, not to mention additional labor costs in production. In view of this, we propose the deep convolutional neural networks (DCNNs) for capturing coffee bean images, while applying non-local block and shift invariant features to enhance the degree of discrimination. The results indicate that the method shows approximately 98% of accuracy based on the F1 score for detecting coffee bean defects. Furthermore, the lightweight model, which only consists of about two hundred thousand parameters is practical in the coffee beans market due a low cost.

articleTitle: Exploration of User Experience in Mixed Reality for Product Virtual Interaction and Display
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: In the post-pandemic era, the strong impact affected the user experience and interaction of products. Web-based online stores also lack intuitive product designs, leading to frequent cognitive disputes. Therefore, a new user experience and interactive approach are continuously researched and discussed. Virtual Reality (VR) and Augmented Reality (AR) provide a Mixed Reality (MR) user experience, which has been influencing business models in the industry since 2020. Additionally, with the emergence of the metaverse at the end of 2021, MR has been recognized as a crucial technology with enormous potential for future demands. However, while many innovative applications of MR have achieved considerable success, they still only focus on entertainment-related experiences and have yet to fully explore the comprehensive range of applications and innovative directions for MR. In such circumstances, we investigated the requirements for user experiences and spatial displays in integrating MR into product experiences. We proposed a novel model that transitions from physical to virtual realms to effectively address the aforementioned challenges. The initial phase involved analyzing the prevailing issues and challenges encountered by users in the product and spatial experience services offered by physical stores and web-based online platforms. Subsequently, the results revealed specific needs were met with the MR technology and alleviated associated pain points. The outcomes of the proposed model provide a reference for future studies to research immersive service experiences within real-world settings with MR devices, thereby removing limitations in space and time.

articleTitle: Research on the Memory Processing Rules of Children in Tang Poetry Reading Using Internal Feature Extraction and Deep Neural Network Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: There are differences in children's cognitive abilities towards Chinese Tang poetry. Several Tang poems are easier for children to learn, while others are difficult. Thus, it is necessary to understand what characteristics of Tang poetry make children find difficult to learn. This problem was modeled as a binary classification problem in machine learning. Firstly, a Tang poetry recitation test was conducted on children, and the average score of all children on each poem was calculated. After data processing, a measure of the difficulty of Tang poetry was determined as the dependent variable for the study. Tang poetry has many characteristics, such as theme type, publication period, and style depending on whether it rhymes, the number of words, number of sentences, sentence length, and whether there are rare characters. These features were selected as independent variables. We constructed two classification models based on the classification and regression tree (CART) and deep neural network methods. The F1 scores of the methods were 80.3 and 84.8%. Although the accuracy of the CART model was slightly lower, it still showed strong interpretability for the characteristics of Tang poetry that were difficult for children to learn. The results can assist in practical teaching.

articleTitle: Separation of Heart and Lung Sounds by A Deep Network-Based Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Breath and heart sounds are the two main biological sound signals. Heart sounds are produced by the beating of the heart caused by blood flows in the heart valves and blood vessels, while lung sounds are produced by the flow of air in and out of the airways during the breathing cycle. Both signals are recorded from the chest area. However, these two signals are mostly superimposed on each other, so it is of great research interest to separate these heart sound signals (HSS) and lung sound signals (LSS). A "Looking to Listen" model developed by Google, is a joint audiovisual model for isolating a single speech signal from a mix of sounds such as other speakers and background noise. In this study, we evaluated the feasibility of separating HSS and LSS by the audio part of the "Looking to Listen" model. We collected the pure HSS (PHSS) and pure LSS (PLSS) data from the public website (kaggle dataset, CoronaHack Respiratory Sound Dataset). Then, heart and lung sounds (MHLS) were combined HSS and LSS with different weighting power (3:7, 5:5, and 7:3). A total of 8076 MHLSs were generated with 72% of the data in the training set, 10% in the validation set, and 18% in the test set. The cross-correlation coefficient (CC) of pure sound and mixed sound and CC of separated and pure sounds were compared to evaluate the efficacy of extraction HSS or LSS from MHLS. The results showed the mean CC was 0.4, 0.7, and 0.9 for pure HSS and MHLS with 3:7, 5:5, and 7:3, respectively; and the mean CC was 0.79, 0.87, and 0.97 for pure HSS and predicted HSS with 3:7, 5:5, and 7:3, respectively. The mean CC was 0.9, 0.7, and 0.4 for pure LSS and MHLS with 3:7, 5:5, and 7:3, respectively. The mean CC was 0.95, 0.91, and 0.81 for pure LSS and predicted LSS with 3:7, 5:5, and 7:3, respectively. The feasibility of separating HSS and LSS by the audio part of the "Looking to Listen" model was validated.

articleTitle: Research on Online Learning Behavior and Learning Effectiveness of College English by Data Mining and Regression Analysis Based on SPOC
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Data mining and regression analysis methods were used to quantitatively analyze the impact of online learning behavior on learning effectiveness. 45 students who took an advanced course of College English "Cross-cultural Communication" were selected as the research subjects in this study, and SPOC online learning data on Chinese university MOOC was used as the data source. Unit tests, assignments, discussion, SPOC exam, video viewing time and number of postings were selected as independent variables, while offline final exams were chosen as dependent variables. The results showed that students’ online discussions, SPOC exam, and unit tests had a significant correlation with the final exam result, while assignments and video viewing time were correlated less with the final exam result. This research result suggested that SPOC course design and SPOC platforms be optimized to improve the effectiveness of online learning.

articleTitle: Research on Direct Yaw Moment Control Based on Neural Sliding Mode Control for Four-Wheel Actuated Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Lateral instability issues such as sharp turns or emergency obstacle avoidance in extreme driving scenarios were solved using direct yaw moment control (DYC). The DYC method was structured hierarchically and included a combination of sliding mode control (SMC) and radial basis function neural network (RBFNN) to calculate the additional required yaw moment for the upper-level control. SMC effectively managed uncertainties and ensured vehicle stability, while RBFNN approximated the entire uncertainties and vehicle dynamic model. The limitations of SMC were addressed in the chattering behavior of control signals and a system model in control design. This model-free control approach for the upper level showed high control performance without relying on a system model, which effectively minimized chattering phenomena in control signals. The lower-level control was designed to distribute torque to each wheel based on the calculated yaw moment. To distribute torque reasonably, a strategy was developed considering the load ratio in the vertical direction of each wheel. The stability of the proposed method was confirmed using Lyapunov stable theory. A simulation was conducted in MATLAB/Simulink, demonstrating that the proposed controller effectively ensured driving stability by closely tracking the desired yaw rate. The controller improved rapid stabilization and convergence and ensured high precision by reducing chattering and robustness in dynamic conditions. The proposed controller functioned effectively without a detailed vehicle dynamics model owing to the implementation of RBFNN-based approximation.

articleTitle: Modal Identification and Optimization Algorithm for Football Players Based on Preparation, Action, Reflection, and Evaluation Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: The iterative reconstruction of the football match scene is conducive to the change of the angle to improve interactivity and immersion. A method for estimating the 3D posture and body shape of football players was proposed as they are the most important elements in football match scenarios. A trained preparation, action, reflection, and evaluation (PARE) model was developed to generate 3D poses and body shapes in multi-view images of players. Manually annotated 2D joint points were used as optimization objectives for the model. The single multi-view optimization was conducted using the differentiability of the parametric Mannequin and its orthogonal projection to map the 3D posture and body shape to 2D joint points. The difference between them and the annotation was calculated using the backpropagation neural network to update the parameters. The process was repeated until the difference was minimized. To validate the proposed method, a dataset of the multiview of players was constructed from a football match. The experiment results demonstrated that the proposed method effectively estimated the 3D posture and body shape of football players. Compared with methods such as human mesh recovery (HMR), SMPL optimization in the loop (SPIN), and synthetic training for accurate 3D human pose and shape (STRAPS), the proposed PARE method improved the accuracy of 2D joint points by 9.2 to 37.5% in a single view and by 34.9 to 54.1% in multiple views.

articleTitle: Novel Road Crack Detection Technology Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Road crack is an important indicator of road detection, and it is necessary to detect pavement cracks. With the continuous progress of science and technology, many methods are applied to crack detection. Traditional detection methods rely on manual identification, which requires technicians to label images one by one, which is inefficient and causes many errors. At the same time, the commonly used image processing methods are easily affected by lighting, pavement stains, and other factors, resulting in unstable detection results. In the research of road surface crack detection, the identification and classification of cracks have been used but the analysis of specific characteristics of cracks is lacking as it is not easy to measure the characteristic value of cracks. Using the deep learning method in computer science and technology, we explored three methods of crack detection and proposed a novel road crack detection technology based on deep learning. Practical Experiments show that our method has excellent performance in road crack detection and crack feature measurement.

articleTitle: Group Similar Images Based on Skeletal Information Extracted from Person's Tracking Path in Real-Time Surveillance System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: In modern society, it is important to count the number of people to monitor absence in class and estimate the number of customers in the store or guests at a wedding. Thus, an application of the real-time surveillance system to discern people is required. In this research, we used an object detection method (YOLO) and the people-tracking method (DeepSort) for tracking people on any occasion. The number of images for each person corresponding to a single ID may be too large to categorize these images. Therefore, we proposed a method for the occlusions of body parts with lightweight OpenPose to group images. This proposed method effectively reduced the amounts of images in each folder by moving the original folder of images into different groups of images. This method also integrated new images. For example, new images were classified to each group and checked if the image appeared before. By grouping the images, we reduced repeated comparisons since the new image was searched in a subgroup rather than in every folder. When images were small and blurry, they might be classified into wrong groups. Therefore, we enlarged and deblurred images for restoration. We employed three different methods for in experiments. We used a set of 10 images with 5 originally classified correctly and the other 5 classified incorrectly. The experimental results showed that 'bilinear interpolation' not only effectively enlarged the images but also extracted accurate features, leading to more correct classifications.

articleTitle: New Experience to Operate Traditional Glove Puppetry on Digital Interactive Stage
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Puppetry is the most distinctive folk craft and local opera in Taiwan. With the development of digital media and changes in entertainment patterns, troupes have chosen to develop towards theatrical performances. They emphasize the combination of puppet body language and story situations to become a new performance type. Using Radio Frequency IDentification (RFID) as the interface between the puppet and stage scenario, an interactive puppet show device "Puppet come on stage" was designed and manufactured. We also designed exclusive audio and video, background, and special effects for characters. Four aspects were defined for the evaluation: operational safety, design innovation, operational convenience, and content appropriateness. The interactive performance was enabled by combining digital audio-visual media and electronic media for leading actors and puppeteers. The system allows traditional skills to continue in the future.

articleTitle: Enhancing Drivers’ Perception of Traffic Lights through Haptic Alerts on the Brake Pedal
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: In recent times, the increase in traffic volume has led to concerns regarding traffic congestion and safety issues. Various approaches utilizing roadway infrastructure and vehicle systems have been proposed to address these challenges. In this context, we focused on human-machine interfaces that can provide direct signals to humans. Haptic alerts have been extensively studied using feedback mechanisms such as steering wheels or seats, and previous research on pedal haptics has primarily aimed at improving safety. However, to the best of the authors’ knowledge, there is a lack of research specifically investigating driver responses when pedal haptic feedback is provided. We propose a novel approach utilizing a motor in the integrated brake system as a feedback method. Our study aims to investigate the promise of haptic alerts on the brake pedal method. Haptic alerts are generated using a motor that activates the integrated brake system, producing waves with specific frequency and amplitude. Using this approach, an simulation on haptic alerts on the brake pedal was conducted, evaluating the position command followability of haptic alerts. The records were obtained by simulating the position control of a three-phase motor for haptic command waveforms with combinations of preset frequencies and amplitudes. The results indicate that haptic alert requires the appropriate frequencies and amplitudes under the performance limits of the system. As part of our future work, we plan to conduct experiments on external environment perception among drivers and evaluate the impact of haptic alerts. Furthermore, we intend to present haptic alert waves with various frequencies and amplitudes to measure the resulting changes in driver response.

articleTitle: Research on Screening Replacement and Energy Harvesting Technology of Microbial Fuel Cells
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: A new control loop method was proposed to improve the detection range through dynamic adjustment to achieve the best power generation for the microbial fuel cell (MFC). A voltage comparator was used in the loop of MFC to solve the problem that the MFC battery is lower than 0.2 V not working properly, so the MFC screening and replacement system included a battery detection unit to realize the maintenance and management of the battery. In the experiment, it was found that in parallel connection, if the voltage was too low, the energy harvesting circuit did not operate wasting energy. The BQ25570 chip was suitable for weak current energy storage at low-power applications.

articleTitle: Computer-Aided Design Application in Determining Minimum Discomfort Glare
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: In this paper, a computational model is proposed by integrating spatial information and the hourly Daylight Glare Probability data through a couple of computer-aided design software to determine minimum discomfort glare for responsive facades. The proposed model is evaluated by parametrically simulating an office with a responsive facade and generating a year of the hourly Daylight Glare Probability data for both horizontal and vertical facade configurations and for five facade locations/climate zones. Then, the Brute-force search algorithm is used to determine the hourly optimum angle of the facade configuration. The computational results show that the proposed optimization model can produce the Daylight Glare Probability values within acceptable range (<0.35) for various facade configurations, facade orientations, and facade locations/climate zones.

articleTitle: Study on Improving Reliability of Synthetic Battery Data with TimeGAN Pre-processing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: While eco-friendly energy is attracting the public’s interest in recent environmental issues, the market of lithium-ion batteries is expanding. Ensuring the safety and reliability of batteries is important in using batteries. Hence, it is essential to monitor the state of health (SOH) of the battery. Model-based SOH estimation has a limitation because battery data exhibit non-linear characteristics according to complex internal changes. To overcome this limitation, the data-based estimation of the SOH of the battery has been researched extensively. Data-based SOH estimation requires a large, high-quality battery dataset. In general, a battery dataset is built based on data obtained from experimental tests. However, this approach is time-dependent. To overcome this problem, data augmentation algorithms are used. TimeGAN is one of the time-series data augmentation algorithms that generate time-series data in the latent space while preserving temporal dynamics and static characteristics. To ensure stable training of data, TimeGAN generates synthetic data after data has been preprocessed using Min-Max scaling. In this study, various preprocessing techniques were applied for TimeGAN to generate more realistic synthetic data which was close to the original battery data. Results based on different preprocessing techniques were analyzed, and the preprocessing technique suitable for generating a battery dataset was proposed. Discriminative and predictive scores were used for evaluation with t-SNE graphs for visual comparison. When Max-Abs scaling and Normalization preprocessing techniques were applied, the discriminative score improved by 53.7 and 44.4%, respectively, compared to the conventional Min-Max scaling.

articleTitle: Design and Development of a User-Centric Wearable Device Application for Elderly Care
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: In this study, Safe Sentery, a healthcare application was designed for the well-being of the elderly. As the global population ages, the prevalence of health risks and medical conditions requiring regular attention increases significantly. In recent years, wearable health applications and real-time health monitoring systems tailored for elderly care have been adopted. Safe Sentery is a comprehensive care platform that seamlessly integrates into the recipients' home life. Utilizing wearable technology, the app can be used for efficient tracking and locating of care recipients with the prompt issuance of emergency notifications during critical situations. Additionally, it helps manage medical records and health history, allowing caregivers to access crucial information about their recipients' well-being including personalized medical details, medication reminders, doctor appointment scheduling, and instant health advice. Safe Sentery ensures continuous care for elderly individuals and comfort at home. The app can be used for family caregivers and enable daily care. It also effectively alleviates the burden on family caregivers, leading to an improved quality of life for both the elderly and caregivers.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Community Health and Elderly Care Service Platform by Computer Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: China's aging population requires elderly care as a social concern. In order to facilitate and serve the elderly at home, a computer technology with health care services was proposed on a community health care service platform that focused on "home care", "health service", "health record management" and "volunteer service". To serve the elderly at home effectively, real-time, fast, efficient, low-cost, interconnected health-care services were proposed.

articleTitle: Detecting Children with Autism Spectrum Disorder Based on Eye-tracking and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) is a neurodevelopmental disorder that appears in childhood with varying severity. Unfortunately, current screening methods for ASD often lack sensitivity. While clinical observation-based evaluations are more reliable, they are also time-consuming. An artificial intelligence (AI) model has the potential to analyze eye-tracking data and provide a more efficient and objective assessment of ASD, potentially reducing diagnosis time and improving accuracy. The model helps children with ASD access necessary medical resources more promptly. In the current study, 58 children aged 4 to 6 years were recruited. The children were presented with static images that were divided into five categories based on the number of individuals and interactions. Eye-tracking technology was used to record various metrics, including fixation count, duration, percentage, and time to the first fixation on areas of interest (AOI) during image viewing. Principal Component Analysis (PCA) was implemented for feature selection, and Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique was used to generate minority samples. Five classification algorithms (Decision Tree, Random Forest, Logistic Regression, Extreme Gradient Boosting, and Support Vector Machine) were applied to classify children with ASD and TD. Both groups of children completed calibration and testing after guidance, and no adverse reactions occurred during the testing process. The results showed that the classification models achieved an SVM accuracy of 83.3%, an AUC of 0.94, an LR accuracy of 83.3%, an AUC of 0.95, a DT accuracy of 77.8%, an AUC of 0.81, an RF accuracy of 88.9%, and an AUC of 0.96, as well as an XGBoost accuracy of 94.4% and an AUC of 0.99 for selected 10 features. Using machine learning methods to analyze eye-tracking data was a useful tool for identifying children with autism and may aid in the diagnostic process.

articleTitle: Security Analysis of Low Earth Orbit Satellites Based on Different Software-Defined Networking Structure
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Under the Software-Defined Networking (SDN) framework, Low Earth Orbit (LEO) operates with its multiple architectures, including Cross-Domain Controller Architecture, Inter-Domain Controller Architecture, and so on. For cross-domain controller structure, the security of the east-west protocol is considered, including the protocols and sources in its secure design. For the inter-domain controller, the south-north bound protocol and software are used. we proposed a method to build a treatment model to provide a mechanism for the abnormal behavior. On these two architectures, we employed a series of security analysis methods and countermeasures. Regarding the security analysis methods, we used software composite analysis (SCA), static application security testing (SAST), and dynamic application security testing (DAST) to assess the potential threats and attack vectors, and then build a threat model. East-west and south-north (application layer) protocols were considered in building the threat model. With this model, the monitor mechanism was established for the abnormal activities. The security performance was evaluated.

articleTitle: Simulation Study on Optimal Allocation Model of English Online Teaching Resources Based on Greedy Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Reasonably allocating English online course resources promotes the efficiency of their uses. In allocating the teaching resources, a large delay may occur, which leads to a long occupation time in the allocation channel. However, the traditional model of using the online teaching resource allocates the resource and tasks to different channels, which takes a long time. When the allocation function runs for a long time, the efficiency is reduced. Thus, a new method was proposed for optimizing the allocation of English online teaching resources in this study. The proposed method used a resource allocation delay model for the main and secondary clients in the network. The model calculated the delay in the resource allocation and automatically configured the transmission rate. Thus, configuration scheduling was enabled with nonlinear optimization. The greedy algorithm was used to obtain a global optimal solution and schedule to use online course resources effectively. The simulation result showed that the model improved the allocation efficiency in using English online course resources.

articleTitle: Exploring Self-Efficacy of Students’ Computer Programming Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Due to the growth of computer technology in business, learning computer programming is necessary for university students regardless of their background in information technology. Self-efficacy is an important factor in students’ learning performance. However, little research has been done on the antecedents of self-efficacy when students learn computer programming. Thus, we proposed a framework based on self-efficacy theory and surveyed to test the hypotheses. The results showed that the quality of lectures, reciprocal help from classmates, and positive emotions had positive effects on self-efficacy, but course value did not. Teachers’ lectures and the cooperation between students were crucial in learning computer programming. Also, students with positive emotions showed a degree of self-efficacy when facing the challenges in learning how to code.

articleTitle: Generation of Modern Pulse Radar Signals for Electronic Warfare Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: An innovative approach is presented to generate modern pulse radar signals specifically designed to meet the demands of electronic warfare (EW) applications in this article. In EW applications, pulse descriptor words (PDWs) are used to represent the characteristics of intercepted emitter signals. With the applications, the architecture of the PDW generator was developed in this study. The user-defined parameters and modulations were also proposed for meeting the demands of EW operations. 1 to 5 PDW parameters were chosen, and 7 pulse repetition interval (PRI) modulations. In addition, the PDW sequences included scenarios with 3 non-ideal pulses. We generated interleaving pulsed trains that incorporated multiple radar modulation techniques. The pulse sequence from each radar was generated based on the specific characteristics of that radar. The results offered a more detailed description of radar pulse signals on the modern battlefield, making them valuable for ESM deinterleaving research.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Analysis Platform of Students Mental Health Based on Big Data Computation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: In order to use big data analysis and artificial intelligence technology for students, educational institutions and parents need to better understand the mental health status of students to support them and provide intervention measures. Thus, we designed an intelligent analysis platform for student mental health to evaluate and predict it by collecting and analyzing multi-dimensional data such as personal information, learning behavior data, and social media activities. By using models and algorithms, the platform identified possible mental health problems of students such as anxiety, depression, and stress, and provided timely warnings and suggestions. At the same time, the platform provided customized mental health support and intervention programs based on students’ personalized needs and characteristics, including online psychological counseling, mental health education resources, and self-help tutoring tools to develop students’ mental health and improve academic achievement.

articleTitle: Unique Feature Extraction and Consistency Network for Skeleton Body Keypoints Configuration and Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: The machine learning algorithm recognizes skeleton poses in many ways but previous methods suffered from higher computation and low latency. To increase solitary person posture accurateness, we developed a novel strategy for fitness-related appliances. The developed design included a basic network that offered a starting point for eminent modification using a Unique Features Extraction Network (UFE Net) for long-term consistency. The UFE Net imposed innovative constraints through local element changes and enhancement of global body properties. The recommended module decreased the effect of varying body key points and inconsistent postures. Using a standard dataset, we showed how effective the suggested approach was. The proposed framework operated rapidly and increased precision on the CPU environment platform. In comparison to previous results, the developed design enhanced accuracy by 98.5% at real-time proceeding rates of 32 FPS.

articleTitle: Decision Support System for Distribution Problems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Distribution problems have become increasingly important with the development of e-commerce. The hub-and-spoke approach is widely accepted for distribution networks and has been developed in many areas including courier services, telecommunications, and airline travel planning. A hub-and-spoke network consists of a series of connections and a few hubs. Such networks indirectly reduce unit transportation and operational costs by taking advantage of economies of scale. In this way, the overall economic benefit of the entire network can be increased. In this study, a hub-and-spoke network was modeled to choose their service levels of the risk of a hub becoming unusable, using intermodal transportation. Hubs become unusable due to weather conditions, natural disasters, labor disputes, and other reasons. In this case, backup hubs need to be assigned to transfer the flows of the unusable hubs to other hubs. Service level can be defined as the arrival of customers' products at their chosen delivery time. Recent studies have shown that carbon emissions become critical if necessary measures are not taken. Additionally, this study result contributes to reducing carbon emissions costs and creating a sustainable distribution network.

articleTitle: Application of Genetic Evolutionary Algorithm on Creative Design of Public Art
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: The standard cultural algorithm has problems of low convergence accuracy and poor application effect in Public art creative design. Thus, an improved genetic evolutionary cultural algorithm was proposed in this research. First, the genetic algorithm was used to provide the population space of the cultural algorithm, then pattern extraction was used to obtain the feature information on excellent individuals. Individuals learned patterns from feature information, using the guiding role of excellent patterns and accelerating the rate of convergence of the algorithm. Simulation experiment results showed that the improved algorithm had better multi-objective optimization accuracy than the standard algorithm and was applied in the innovative design of public art.

articleTitle: Design of Model Predictive Control-based Optimal Charging Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Lithium-ion (Li-ion) batteries are used in a multitude of applications including portable consumer electronics, electric vehicles, and large-scale energy storage systems. The development of an optimal charging algorithm for the management of charging time and temperature rise is crucial for maximizing the life of Li-ion batteries. Thus, we introduced a charging algorithm based on model predictive control. The incorporation of the model in battery optimization control offers significant benefits, particularly in computational efficiency. A comparative analysis with the commonly used constant current-constant voltage (CC-CV) charging method indicated that the proposed algorithm enhanced charging speed and reduced temperature rise significantly.

articleTitle: Research on Urban Construction Waste Recycling Route Based on MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Construction waste recycling requires the modeling of recycling routes to increase its utilization rate. Therefore, we developed a single-objective model considering environmental and social impacts using the decision criterion. The transportation flow and construction waste treatment capacity were considered in the model with environmental and social impacts as the constraints. The model was solved by MATLAB (matrix laboratory). The model was validated as a scientific and convenient tool for the planning of recycling routes of construction wastes.

articleTitle: Platooning of Connected Automated Vehicles at Intersections
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Traffic efficiency and safety were improved by platooning connected autonomous vehicles. In this study, an optimized speed model was proposed for platooning CAVs traveling through V2I-regulated intersections without stop-and-go driving behavior in corridors to support human-driven vehicles. The platooning decision at the V2I-regulated traffic intersection was developed to enable platooning to pass the intersection in the least amount of time based on V2V communication and traffic light depending on the remaining seconds. The results of the simulation and on-road experiments showed that the proposed methodology allowed the platoon to safely pass through V2I traffic light intersections and improved the efficiency of passing through intersections by 10% without a vehicle in front.

articleTitle: A (t, n)-Threshold Visual Secret Sharing Scheme Based on Polarization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: With the development of technology, people pay more attention to the development of encryption methods. Visual secret sharing (VSS), also called visual cryptography (VC), involves encrypting a secret image into several images (called shares) that can be stacked together to reveal the secret image. The decryption method in the traditional VSS is equivalent to using logical OR operation. A new VSS idea based on the polarization of light waves was proposed in 1997. Two types of polarizers, vertical and horizontal, are used to generate the light waves. It is customary to regard the vertical polarizer as 1, and the horizontal polarizer as 0, and regard the result of the stacking of two polarizers as a logical XOR operation on two corresponding values. However, this interpretation produces errors when stacking more than two polarizers. Therefore, a new interpretation way is required for VSS based on the polarization of light, called P-VSS. Therefore, we proposed a novel (t, n)-threshold P-VSS scheme based on polarization. The experimental results and theoretical analysis showed that the proposed scheme was more efficient compared with previous studies and outperformed traditional VC schemes.

articleTitle: Development of Assist Mechanisms for Lifting Luggage Using the Lower Limbs
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: According to the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries, the average age of agricultural workers is becoming a serious problem worldwide due to the declining birthrate and aging population. In addition, the harvesting of agricultural products requires storage and transportation in containers, and it has been pointed out that this work is burdensome not only to the elderly but also to people of all ages. For this reason, power-assist devices and other devices are being developed worldwide. However, in general, such devices are complicated and expensive, so they are not widely used by individual farmers and households. To solve these problems, we developed a simple, trouble-free, and inexpensive power-assist device for lifting and carrying loads. The power source for this device was not a motor or hydraulic or pneumatic pressure as in conventional devices. It was the "thigh muscles of the workers" used in Japanese martial arts that exerted the greatest force in the body. Another feature of this device was using shoulder muscles to hold the load, rather than arm muscles. This device contributes to the development of the agricultural sector in an aging society with a declining birthrate and supports the securing of safe food for future generations.

articleTitle: Intelligent Electrolytic Silver Control System Based on ARM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: We proposed an electrolytic silver wireless intelligent control system based on ARM. Based on the existing electrolytic silver technology, an intelligent electrolytic silver system was designed in this paper. A single-chip microcomputer was used for programmed control to improve the defects of the anode slime in the melting process. Using the electrolysis process, the speed of the anode slime production was slowed down, and a silver electrolyzer for high-current density production was designed and developed. The new technology of an intelligent electrolytic silver control system for intellectual property was verified by experiments, which indicated that the control system improved the electrolytic efficiency of electrolytic silver.

articleTitle: Finger-Vein Recognition Using ResNet with Elastic Margin Loss
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: As technology evolves, people are starting to value the safety of their personal information more than ever. However, traditional keys and passwords as security features are subject to vulnerabilities, prompting a flux of new methods of biometric recognition with deep learning (DL). We proposed the RestNet model and elastic margin loss to perform a finger-vein recognition system. Experimental results indicated that the proposed DL architecture showed that precision, recall, F1-score, and accuracy metrics were higher than 99% in the FV-USM dataset.

articleTitle: A Study of International Sharing Mechanisms of Chinese Learning Resource Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: The purpose of this study was to establish a model for sharing international Chinese learning resources. The research was carried out in two parts: model design and testing. In the model design, we used blockchain technology to create a mechanism that enabled the sharing of resources. This mechanism consisted of four layers: data storage, network consensus, intelligent contracts, and application services. In the testing phase, we evaluated the performance and analyzed the data of the shared model. The results demonstrated that this model provided secure and reliable resource acquisition services for Chinese learners worldwide. It facilitated collaborative resource construction and sharing, thereby promoting the development of international Chinese education. The innovation of this research was presented by the application of blockchain technology to international Chinese education.

articleTitle: Approximate Posture Increment Control for the Targeting Task of Differential Drive Robots
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Differential drive robots (DDRs) are an effective and efficient solution for many mobile robotics applications. These kind of robots are a type of mobile robots that are characterized by their use of two independently controlled wheels. DDRs are highly maneuverable, as they can rotate in a narrow space, move sideways, and make tight turns. This makes them ideal for applications that require precise positioning and navigation, such as inspection, exploration, and search and rescue. Therefore, most of the research focuses on tracking problems in which information of the reference trajectories are known. Different from the typical Laypunov based DDR’s tracking control algorithm, a targeting control task which focuses on pointing and chasing a target point using only the target position is presented. Considering an approximated discrete time representation of DDR dynamics, a simple targeting scheme is proposed in the form of the so-called approximate pose increment control (APIC). Based on the proposed method, the use of coordinate transformation as well as a Lyapunov function are no longer needed to achieve the desired control goal. Simulations demonstrate multiple targeting courses to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed APIC algorithm.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-based System for Real-time Segmented Timing and Acceleration Analysis in Swimming
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Computer vision-based motion tracking has gained significant attention in various areas including sports. We developed a deep learning (DL)-based system combined with object tracking techniques to track swimmers’ information in swimming using real-time automatic segmented timing. The proposed system improved the efficiency of swimmer training and enabled coaches and athletes to evaluate their performance and adjust their practice methods. The system incorporated a YOLOv4-tiny tracking model to detect and track swimmers in real-time. This model was trained with approximately 100,000 images captured by underwater and above-water cameras. The system continuously tracked and marked the swimmers' positions using bounding boxes (Bbox). Segmented timing was determined by analyzing the time for the bounding box to cross predefined reference lines within the image. The system also used side-view image tracking, too to detect swimmer positions. Swimming data were displayed including segmented timing. The proposed system offered benefits for swimmers and coaches. Swimmers could monitor their progress, track their swim speed, and improve performance. Coaches evaluated swimming techniques, identified what to improve, and customized training plans based on real-time feedback and detailed analysis. The real-time automatic segmented timing and display of swimmers' tracking data provided a comprehensive overview of the performance and efficient training in swimming.

articleTitle: Research on Load Balancing Model of Vehicle-to-everything Communication Transmission Resources Based on Improved Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: We proposed a computing offload and resource optimization model for the vehicle-to-everything to solve dependent delays caused by the dual dependency relationship of tasks in time sequence and data and with load imbalance of computing. An algorithm to estimate delay and energy consumption was developed by using the dependency relationship of subtasks. According to the principle of the auction, a platform for computing data was established with a load balance algorithm and multi-access edging computer (MEC) based on load. For the topological sorting of dependent tasks, the topological sorting algorithm was used. Optimization problems were created for joint optimization of offloading decisions, data allocation, and load balancing. The coding with particle swarm optimization (PSO) and genetic model was created to propose an adaptive PSO hybrid model. The simulation result showed that the platform overhead was optimized to solve the problem of maximum tolerance and improve the overall load balance of the limbic system.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Based Low-Complexity Image Feature Descriptor for MPEG-CDVS Standard
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Compact descriptors for visual search (CDVS) is a completed standard from the ISO/IEC moving pictures experts group (MPEG). CDVS has a low complexity and bitrate efficiency on image matching and retrieval. The MPEG CDVS framework detects key feature points in the image and extracts descriptors to obtain bitstreams to match images. We proposed a low-complexity image descriptor for visual searching within the MPEG CDVS framework. The proposed algorithm integrated traditional image processing methods with a machince learning (ML) network, resulting in reduced compression time and the size of the CDVS standard bitstream. To evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm, we tested the proposed algorithm with the CDVS standard software to ensure its compatibility. On the CDVS-Benchmark, the experimental results demonstrated that the proposed algorithm reduced matching time by 31.7%, bitstream size by 31.8%, and extracting time by 12.8% compared to the CDVS standard test model. Similarly, on the HPatches-Benchmark, the proposed algorithm reduced matching time by 5.3%, bitstream size by 25.2%, and extracting time by 32.0% compared to the CDVS standard test model.

articleTitle: Feature Extraction and Deep Neural Network Method Based Research on Cognitive Law of Students in Reading Comprehension in Chinese
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: The problem of students' cognitive differences in reading comprehension in Chinese was modeled as a binary classification problem in Machine Learning. The average score of the student group in reading comprehension was normalized and binarized to obtain the difficulty label as the dependent variable for the study. Reading comprehension was affected by the genre of the article, the number of words, the number of sentences, the average number of Chinese characters contained in each sentence, the proportion of rare characters, and so on. These features were selected as independent variables for this study. Based on the Decision Tree (DT) method and the Deep Neural Network (DNN) method, two classification models were constructed. The F1 score was 82.3 and 86.7%, respectively, for the two methods with high accuracy. Although the accuracy of the DT model was slightly lower, the model was more interpretable. The result showed the pictorial features of the difficulty in reading comprehension in Chinese for teaching.

articleTitle: Authority transfer According to Driver Intervention Intention Considering Coexistence of Communication Delay
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: With the development of autonomous driving technology, research and development have been conducted on safety-related functions to assist autonomous driving. Despite hardware safety-integrity levels being sufficiently considered in self-driving safety, issues of potential collisions originating from software’s ambiguity ous remain due to unexpected system errors. The errors must be diminished to acceptable risk levels. To compensate for this, vehicle monitoring and remote control technologies were proposed for autonomous vehicles. Unpredictable communication delays between autonomous vehicles and the control center cause potential hazards. Thus, we presented case studies and authority transfer methods considering communication delays. The effect of delayed control of vehicle teleoperation was also explored with communication delay. The result showed that the proposed method compensated for communication delay in remote authority transfer and increased the driver’s intervention.

articleTitle: Design Knowledge Perception and Representation Method for User Requirements
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: The user’s requirements for product design include descriptiveness, dynamics, and personalization. The insufficient mapping of User requirement knowledge seriously affects the accuracy of designers’ grasp of design ideas and design knowledge. For this issue, we proposed a design knowledge perception and representation method for user requirements. Design knowledge from user requirement question and answer (Q&A) was extracted, including design theme, design content, and design evaluation to improve communication efficiency between designers and users. A representation method was proposed for User requirement knowledge based on the Q&A of the user’s initiating requirements and the product provider’s solutions. A design requirement framework for expressing design intent was proposed by perceiving dialogue context. Furthermore, the rule of design requirement was derived based on attributes in User requirement knowledge for designers. Finally, the knowledge perception, representation method, and knowledge framework of air conditioners were analyzed to determine the knowledge rules. The results indicated that the knowledge perception and representation method proposed in this study accurately reflected User requirement knowledge and provided sufficient knowledge for product design. At the same time, the extracted design requirement was shared among different decision-makers, providing a theoretical basis for group decision-making.

articleTitle: Computer Aided Simulation on Reliability of Valve Train Friction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: The valve train is an important part of the diesel engine combustion chamber and the valve-valve seat insert friction pair, as they are the main friction pair of the diesel engine valve train. In the valve train, the collision occurs frequently, which wears the engine and affects the power and fuel economy of the engine. In this study, the reliability of the valve train friction was researched by computer-aided simulation. The wear degree data of the friction pair were collected by simulation. Using the Gamma distribution model, the increment of valve wear was estimated. This incremental model of the valve wear ith Monte-Carlo simulation predicted the pseudo-life of the valve under the set threshold. It provided a reference for the service life of the valve.

articleTitle: Indicators for Smart Quality Model: A Delphi-Analytical Hierarchical Process (AHP)
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Smart Quality is required in the early stage of development. Therefore, it is necessary to clarify the advantages and disadvantages of implementing Smart Quality. The literature review results showed that more empirical research on Smart Quality was needed. Several factors must be considered seriously in implementing Smart Quality. Managers need to identify the factors that need the most attention and to be implemented to ensure the benefits of Industry 4.0 technology. To determine whether a company is ready to adopt Smart Quality, empirical research is needed to assess the readiness factors of smart quality. By ranking the readiness factors, organizations need to focus on the factors for the greatest result. In this article, we explored how to select variables and formulated questions for future research.

articleTitle: Defect Detection of Wood Grain Images with Image Gradient Applied to AE-based generation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Detecting and managing various types of defects that occur in the manufacturing process is important for product quality control. Detecting flaws in product presentation is an ongoing research topic in computer vision. Recently, deep learning technology has been used to improve defect detection performance compared to traditional computer vision methods. In this study, we proposed a new method for detecting defects on the surface of wooden boards using image reconstruction with an autoencoder-based model and image gradient filters in image processing using edge detection. Although the reconstruction performance of the autoencoder is significantly inferior to the newest technologies, this characteristic is used to remove noise from input images. We used the publicly available anomaly detection dataset, MV-Tec AD, for training and evaluation and presented experimental results focusing on the "Wood" category. The proposed method in this study demonstrated better detection performance with image processing.

articleTitle: Impact of Immersive Virtual Reality Technology on Skill Training
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: The integration of digital technology into teaching and self-learning has yielded remarkable results. However, there are not many research results on the utilization of new technology media in vocational skills training courses. Thus, we developed a virtual reality hygiene-skills training (VR-HST) system to assist in administering training for health skills practice tests. The objective of this study was to examine the impact of this system on learners' learning effectiveness and motivation during vocational skills certificate testing. We recruited 60 student participants from a fashion modeling department who were preparing to take a hygiene skills practice test. In this research, we adopted a quasi-experimental design in which the experimental group received VR-based training, whereas the control group received training based on traditional teaching methods. The experiment was conducted over 6 weeks. The results indicated that the experimental group with the assistance of the VR-HST learning improved their motivation and outperformed the control group in hygiene skills practice. Therefore, incorporating the VR-HS system into the traditional master-apprentice skill teaching and training effectively enhanced the training effectiveness.

articleTitle: Design of Blended Teaching Platform for Aerobics Courses Based on Wearable Virtual VR
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: To teach intricate skills that are not learned and mastered in traditional aerobic courses, we used augmented reality (AR) technology. Features such as virtual-real fusion, information interaction, and tracking registration were used in the AR system. The AR system enhanced real-time interaction and enabled 3D panoramic exploration using wearable virtual reality (VR) devices. Visualization and interactive technology were developed with tools such as 3D MAX and Blender in the system. Vuforia SDK was chosen as the suitable AR framework. The hybrid online-offline information teaching system based on AR technology was also created using Photon distributed computing solution and Unity 3D graphics program. The system facilitated online communication and education and provided offline self-learning and training for students. The teacher used a mobile terminal to zoom in or flip the overlapped 3D model against a real background. This method effectively presented complex skills for students to understand and learn.

articleTitle: Effective Navigation for an Emergency Response for Firefighters with Wearable Haptic Displays Design
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Firefighters face numerous challenges during emergency response situations, including limited visibility, unfamiliar environments, and high-stress conditions. These factors limit their ability to navigate effectively and efficiently, leading to an increased risk of injury or loss of life. Therefore, we introduced a wearable haptic display system integrated with firefighter uniforms to enhance navigation and situational awareness during emergency response operations. The proposed system included haptic actuators embedded in the firefighter uniform and leverages Internet of Things (IoT) technology to deliver real-time haptic feedback. This feedback offered intuitive and non-intrusive cues that guided firefighters through complex environments, alert them to potential hazards, and convey critical information from command centers. For the requirements analysis that encompasses navigation, alerting, and information transmission, we outlined the haptic feedback design for firefighters in the emergency in the fire. We described the system architecture using the Internet of Things (IoT) technology. The wearable haptic firefighter uniforms helped firefighters navigate and respond to emergencies, ultimately enhancing safety and effectiveness in high-risk environments.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Deep Learning Algorithms for Instance Segmentation on Cassava Root
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Different algorithms were developed and evaluated for segmenting images of cassava roots. Cassava CSRs (CSR) have different shapes and sizes. Existing methods rely on image processing algorithms to segment CSR, but these often have problems with overlapping fibrous roots. In this study, deep learning architectures for instance segmentation HTC, SOLOv2, and Mask R-CNN were applied to CSR data to investigate whether these models can overcome the specific challenges of this domain. We created a custom dataset with 1,227 training, 100 validation, and 100 test images of CSRs with different root systems and high-quality segmentation masks. Then, we compared the result of the SOLOv2 model to the Mask R-CNN and HTC models using the same network architecture. The standard metric for comparing instance segmentation models in computer vision such as mean average precision, was used for the evaluation. The results showed that all tested models applied to the considered area showed good prediction accuracy. SOLOv2 showed the best results on the test set with the computation of the model less than that of HTC. Increasing the model complexity and size did not impact the prediction accuracy in the instance segmentation of CSR. HTC achieved almost the same result as that of the SOLOv2 model but required almost doubling the number of parameters. The visualization of the predictions showed quality differences in terms of the accuracy of the segmentation masks. The SOLOv2 model showed the best masks overall. However, each model had problems in assigning the segmentation masks due to the overlap of a CSR. Many root systems still need to be measured for gene discovery and subsequent breeding. The results demonstrated the potential of deep learning instance segmentation models for CSRs needs to be increased with further research.

articleTitle: Applying an AI Predictive Model in Detecting High-Risk Erectile Dysfunction Patients with an M-Health System to Prevent Disease Deterioration
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Erectile dysfunction (ED) is characterized by difficulty in attaining or maintaining an adequate erection during sexual activity and is associated with related comorbidities. Hence, designing predictive systems based on features related to acquired comorbidities is effective in predicting the occurrence of ED for high-risk patients. Annual visits of ED patients were significantly less than those without ED according to the data from the National Health Insurance Research Database. We applied the developed ED predictive model to find high-risk patients for early intervention by designing an m-Health system for managing comorbidities and avoiding disease deterioration so that ED occurrences can be reduced. An m-Health system integrating health educational materials and regular reminding of visiting physicians was designed for managing comorbidities associated with ED. The developed ED predictive model was applied to the urological clinic for detecting patients with higher risk of developing ED. To verify the effectiveness of the m-Health intervention, a total of 31 high-risk patients were recruited for the m-Health intervention. The participants were asked to install an m-Health APP on their smartphones before intervention as well as to fill SHIM questionnaire at the baseline and after 6 months of m-Health intervention. The TAM questionnaires were also obtained after the intervention. The paired t-test was conducted to compare SHIM scores between baseline and post-intervention, while the one-sample t-test (neutral value=3) was applied to analyze the TAM surveys. The SHIM score after m-Health intervention exhibited significantly greater than the baseline (14.78±8.96 vs 12.70±8.45, p<0.05), indicating m-Health intervention is useful in improving ED symptoms. The perceived usefulness was validated with the result of the TAM survey. The participants strongly (p<0.001) agreed that the m-Health system was useful in managing comorbidities (4.13±0.54) and alleviating ED symptoms (3.65±0.76) with a QoL of 4.00±0.59. Such results show that the ED m-Health system is useful for consolidating appropriate lifestyles for patients who may develop ED.

articleTitle: Designing Researchmap: A Revolutionary Scholar Support Platform Achieved Through Human-AI Collaboration
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Researchmap is a researcher support platform software-as-a-service (SaaS) that has successfully achieved the semi-automated construction of a comprehensive catalog of achievements for over 340,000 Japanese researchers through the collaboration of artificial intelligence (AI) and human expertise. Researchmap utilizes APIs from primary information providers such as Scopus to compile a substantial portion of researchers' achievement lists. This curated dataset then serves as training data for AI development. The AI model is iteratively refined by providing feedback to the users (i.e.researchers), allowing them to make corrections and improvements using a user-friendly interface. As a result of these efforts, Researchmap successfully captures information from more than 340,000 researchers within the Japanese academia, accumulating over 20 million research achievements in machine-readable formats. The F1 Score of AI in recommending discovered research achievements to the respective researchers exceeds 0.94.

articleTitle: Transient Group Recommendation for Shared Environment using Check-in and Tag Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Group Recommendation Systems (GRSs) are crucial in facilitating decision-making processes for shared playlists. However, recommending appropriate items is challenging when it comes to dynamic and transient groups such as restaurant customers. Thus, we proposed a hybrid GRS designed to address these difficulties. By combining collaborative filtering and content-based recommendations enriched with tag information, the proposed system used historical and current check-in data to predict future group composition and tailor recommendations accordingly. The system generated top-N music playlists for every period of the week and provided diverse and novel recommendations prepared before customers’ arrival. We enhanced recommendation performance by extending the traditional user-item matrix with tags and combining memory-based and model-based computation. The proposed method was tested with two real-world datasets. The result showed the improvement of the performance over popularity-based item selection, offering a promising approach for transient group recommendation in a shared environment.

articleTitle: Knowledge Distillation Boosted Ultra-light Weight Road Object Detection on Edge Device
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Road object detection is required for automatic driving and intelligent traffic control and detecting illegal behavior. However, many edge computing devices do not have high computing power. Therefore, it is necessary to deploy a lightweight object detection model while maintaining its performance. Thus, we developed a scenario on the 24-hour automatic patrol camcorder for the corners and alleys. The device instantly identified and detected suspicious vehicles or pedestrians and sent notifications. Hence, the model had low complexity and efficiency to meet the requirement of real-time detection. We improved the model's precision within the limited inference time. In the experiment, YOLOv5 was selected as the base model for lightweight model construction on the Snapdragon 660 Mobile Platform on Xiaomi Mi A2. The designed model YOLOv5p with parameter size 0.7 M boosted knowledge distillation from mean average precision (mAP) of 18 to 19.3% on the BDD100K dataset.

articleTitle: Eye Detection in Image of Face with Mask from Various Viewpoints by Haar-based Cascade Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Existing research on facial mask-worn face detection has limitations when applied to non-frontal face images. To improve the performance, side-view faces must be analyzed. The eye detection process is to analyze side-view face images. Therefore, we proposed an eye detection method from face images by a Haar-based cascade technique. Input data were images of frontal faces, non-frontal faces, face with mask, and face without mask. The face angle varied from negative 90 to positive 90 degrees. The proposed method consisted of the following process: 1) Database preparation, 2) Identification of head area and Center of the Head Calculation method installation, 3) a Haar-based Cascade Object Detector for Eye detection in angled faces preparation, 4) Eye side identification conditioning and 5) Implement of eye detection. To test the performance of the proposed method, 250 face images were used to measure the accuracy of each viewpoint of test images. In eye detection, the accuracy reached 86% for -90°, 90% for -45°, 88% for 0°, 90% for 45°, and 78% for 90°. The performance of the proposed method was satisfactory.

articleTitle: Fault Recovery in Spiking Neural Networks Through Target and Selection of Faulty Neurons for 3D Spiking Neuromorphic Processors
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Neuromorphic systems integrate features inspired by the neurobiological system which makes them suitable for many cognitive applications like facial recognition, autonomous driving, and bio-medicine. SNN is implemented in these systems for asynchronous information processing with energy efficiency. Many cognitive applications, however, require large numbers of highly interconnected neurons which are often noisy as a result of interference from both internal and external sources. Due to this, these neurons develop faults over time and their computation output becomes unreliable. In this paper, first, we investigated the effect of faulty neurons in spiking neural networks (SNNs). Afterward, we propose a recovery method ’target and selection’ (TSM) for fault recovery in terms of model classification accuracy. In SNN models with stuck-at (SA) faults, TSM identifies and removes all faulty neurons less complexly. Evaluation results show that with the proposed fault recovery method, we could achieve a classification accuracy loss of less than 4% in SA faulty SNNs far less than using the proposed previous fault recovery method at a high fault rate.

articleTitle: Exploring the Vulnerability of Implementing DDoS Detection Systems based on Random-Forest Classifiers and Open Datasets
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: DDoS attacks are threats to governments and IT industries as they can render important computing servers and networks inaccessible. Random forest classifiers are efficient and effective in detecting DDoS attacks when they are used with a large number of training samples to build up an accurate model. However, it is extremely difficult for IT professionals to construct a DDoS training dataset because a realistic DDoS attack scheme is characterized by a large swarm of geographically dispersed computers simultaneously flooding the victim server with superfluous requests. To overcome this difficulty, most of the existing DDoS-detection studies use open datasets to train their random-forest model. While the aforementioned methodology provides a convenient way to conduct academic research, it may not be safe in practice. Thus, we explored the vulnerability of implementing DDoS detection systems based on random-forest classifiers and open datasets. Using a publicly accessible machine-learning library named Scikit-learn and an open DDoS dataset named CIC-DDoS2019, we implemented random-forest-based DDoS detection for a security risk assessment.

articleTitle: Exploiting Monocular Depth Estimation for Style Harmonization in Landscape Painting
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Style harmonization, also known as painterly image harmonization, is a technique to seamlessly blend objects from realistic photos into the background of paintings of different styles. While deep learning-based methods have produced satisfactory results, there are important factors to consider for successful style harmonization depending on the type of image being targeted. In particular, if a certain region of the target image takes up a large portion of the entire image, the object to be blended is largely affected by the region, failing to achieve plausible results of object conversion synthesis. In this study, focusing on landscape painting in which a significant portion of the entire image is occupied by sky regions, we proposed a novel method dubbed Dominant Region Discarding (DRD) that effectively removed the sky region with the monocular depth estimation and Segment Anything Model (SAM). The experimental results showed that the proposed method outperformed previous style harmonization methods.

articleTitle: Topological Characteristics and Robustness of Bus Stop Network in Hefei City
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: For the analysis of topological characteristics and robustness of the bus network, a statistical analysis method based on complex network theory was proposed. For the Hefei bus network, we constructed a bus station network topology model based on the Space-L method based on the complex network theory. Network topology features such as degree distribution and the shortest path were determined, and the clustering coefficient of the model was calculated as the relative value of global efficiency and maximum connectivity rate of the bus network. The coefficients were used as the evaluation indexes of robustness. The robustness of the bus network based on the deletion of bus network stations was simulated according to the number of degrees. The results showed that the Hefei bus network was a small but scale-free network in Space L, and the robustness of the bus network was improved.

articleTitle: Effects of Artificial Intelligence and Robots on Job Satisfaction and Turnover Intention
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: The competitive edge created by advanced technology in a company is indisputably evident. However, advanced technology may harm employee attitudes. The adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) and robots may replace workers. Hence, many workers are worried about employment security. Few studies quantitatively demonstrated these negative aspects of technology. Therefore, we clarified the influence of technology on job satisfaction and turnover intention of employees. Structural equation modeling was applied to an online survey of 571 full-time employees of small and medium enterprises (SMEs) in Japan. The results showed that the introduction of basic technology had a positive effect on job satisfaction and the introduction of advanced technology had a positive effect on turnover intention, while removal of old technology had no significant effect. Accordingly, managers must not underestimate the basic technical environment but implement it quickly. In addition, when introducing cutting-edge technology, managers must give due consideration to employee concerns about employment security. If the purpose and scope of impact are not carefully explained to employees before the technology is introduced, employee turnover increases. We clarified the effects of old, basic, and new technologies on employee attitudes for the first time.

articleTitle: Multimodal Framework for Fake Messages Detection with Textual and Facial Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Besides sharing text messages, the direct and rapid dissemination of images and video has become increasingly common in social media. However, it has become less common for people to critically evaluate and confirm the authenticity of a message before receiving it. Previous research focused on text recognition or account authenticity but less focused on integrated multimedia promotional materials. In this article, we proposed a framework to recognize face data embedded with text in a message and deal with multimodal information. We combined Tesseract Optical Character Recognition (OCR) with Local Binary Pattern Histogram (LBPH) face training to recognize texts and faces. By extracting and analyzing pictures or posters circulated on social media, we identified and confirmed the information of a specific individual, as well as the text content related to it. We developed a system in which Tesseract OCR and LBPH face recognition showed an accuracy of 95.5 and 92.7%.

articleTitle: Design of Fire Spot Recognition System for Indoor Inspection Robots
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: In an indoor fire, the robot inspection process is impossible. The development of the robot and the Internet of Things (IoT) technology provides a new solution for indoor fire identification by a robot. Using IoT technology and inspection robots, we designed a point identification system for an indoor fire to improve the safety and application of the robot inspection. In the system, temperature, smoke, and other sensors were used to detect the temperature, smoke, and other indoor. A microcontroller (MCU) and other components were used for the processing and analysis of data, the control of application programs, and the real-time warning. Through testing and verification, the indoor fire point identification system improved the identification and fire warning in simulated fires. The system ensures personal and property safety by preventing diasters.

articleTitle: Tamper Resistance Evaluation of Midori128 against Differential Power Analysis
