publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: The use of lightweight cryptography enhances the security of the Internet of Things (IoT) devices. Midori is one of the typical lightweight ciphers. Although the cryptographic algorithm is computationally secure, the risk of side-channel analysis (SCA) has been pointed out. For tamper resistance evaluation, it is important to evaluate various power analysis methods. Midori128 has been evaluated using correlation power analysis and deep learning-based power analysis. However, no evaluation has been reported for differential power analysis (DPA) though it is a typical power analysis method. Therefore, we proposed a DPA method of Midori128 for tamper resistance evaluation. In the experiment, Midori128 was implemented in a field programmable gate array. Then, we measured the power consumption waveforms and evaluated the tamper resistance using actual measured waveform data. As a result, the proposed method was used to successfully estimate more than 93% of secret keys by using 5,000 waveforms and showed that the tamper resistance of Midori128 can be quantitatively evaluated.

articleTitle: Parameter Estimation of PRRR Robotic Arm Using Dandelion Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: We introduced artificial intelligence (AI) techniques to estimate the parameters of a robotic arm of a multi-degree of freedom based on pre-knowledge. The Dandelion optimizer was used for the algorithm. Metaheuristic technique was designed to imitate the movement of dandelion seeds. The algorithm estimated the parameters with a root mean squared error (RMSE) of 3.2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">‒8</sup> and a mean absolute error (MAE) of less than 10.6%.

articleTitle: Analysis of Tweet Sentiment and Propagation Graph of Twitter Users
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: The social network shows a rapid growth of the number of users of Twitter and has become one of the main applications of the social network. Twitter users are interested in information such as the correlation between their tweets and other people's reactions, the sentiment of specific keywords, the trend of volume, and the replies to specific tweets. We analyzed Twitter users' tweet sentiment and propagation graph using machine learning. We used the Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) learning model. We crawled users’ tweets from the platform as a dataset for the sentiment analysis model. Emotions were classified into four categories in this study: joy, anger, sadness, and neutrality. We divided the dataset into training and test sets, which included 1000 pieces and 200 pieces of data respectively. The model was trained for 6 epochs in total, and the loss and accuracy values of each training set were calculated. It was found that the accuracy rate reached 88.1%. We analyzed the trained model using the data obtained from the Twitter API, such as "love", "retweet", "reply", and "tweet content" to draw the tweets propagation graph, keyword trends, and replies to specific tweets. The results help users understand other users and can be used to identify potential users who need help.

articleTitle: Learning-Based Collision Detection with Estimating Occluded Keypoint for Robotic Manipulators
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: The increasing importance of industry 4.0 expanded the applications of robotic manipulators. Due to the increase in the number of robotic manipulators at work, the probability of collision becomes a prominent threat. As a result, the urgency for real-time collision detection rises. Thus, we proposed a learning-based collision detection with estimating occluded keypoint for robotic manipulators based on the DeepLabCut toolbox keypoint model and depth camera. By identifying key points in robotic manipulators, we detect collisions through the distance formula and occlusion estimation. The experimental results indicate that method achieves 88.14% accuracy with a speed of 22.91 frames per second (FPS). Due to the characteristics of accuracy and high operation speed, it is suitable for real-time collision detection in realistic environments.

articleTitle: Research on Shape Adjustment Algorithm for FAST Reflective Panels
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: The Five-hundred-meter Aperture Spherical radio Telescope (FAST) is the second-largest single-dish radio telescope in the world, designed for high-sensitivity observations in radio astronomy. FAST achieves the optimal reception of celestial electromagnetic waves reflected on its panels by adjusting their shapes to closely match the ideal parabolic shape. In this study, two scenarios of shape adjustment modeling for the reflective panels were created with the assumption of establishing a spatial Cartesian coordinate system with the origin at the center of the reference sphere. The scenarios included the cases when the observed celestial object was directly above the z-axis of FAST and when the observed celestial object had an azimuth angle of 36.795° and an elevation angle of 78.169° for FAST. A numerical analysis model based on the displacement of the main cable nodes was introduced to determine the ideal parabolic surface. This model comprehensively evaluated the given ideal parabolic surface model based on the displacements of the main cable nodes in the radial, latitudinal, and longitudinal directions, as well as factors such as the radial displacement at the edge and numerical adjustments. Additionally, a shape adjustment model for the reflective panels was proposed to calculate the extension or contraction of different main cable nodes and obtain the optimal adjustment scheme for the FAST reflective panels.

Author Keywords: cable node displacement numerical analysis model

articleTitle: Lightweight Deep Convolution Neural Network for Green Coffee Bean Defects Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: The demand for high-quality coffee in the global market has increased. However, large labor resources are still required for sorting beans in coffee production due to different manual screening standards. Thus, maintaining consistency in the quality of coffee beans poses a challenge. However, computer vision (CV) based on lightweight deep convolutional neural networks (DCNNs) was used to detect coffee bean defects and evaluate the proposed model’s structure. The proposed method was trained with the public coffee bean database. The experiment result showed a high recognition performance even with a small number of parameters achieving 96.00% of the F1-Score.

articleTitle: Research on Scene Development and Simulation of Environmental Art Design System Based on VR
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: In environmental art design, scene-switching time is crucial as it affects the overall user experience. Traditional systems suffer from slow scene switching times due to their reliance on outdated technology and hardware limitations. Thus, VR (VR) technology was applied in the construction of an environmental art design system. The new system used a hardware framework specifically designed for VR applications. This allowed for faster data processing and conversion between different formats within the system. The result showed an efficient and seamless environment where users easily navigated through various scenes without any lag or delay. One of the key advantages of this new system was the improved efficiency by 30% compared with previous optimization efforts. Designers completed their work in a shorter time while still maintaining high-quality standards. Overall, the application of VR technology in environmental art design improved user experience significantly. With faster scene-switching and improved efficiency, designers can create immersive environments more easily than ever before, providing users with an unparalleled level of engagement and enjoyment.

articleTitle: Deliberate Occlusion: Asymmetry in Facial Expression
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Facial expression recognition (FER) has become increasingly common in research. However, region feature technologies that play an important role in this field have not been well developed. In this study, a psychology-based solution to address problems in FER of regional features was proposed. This method employs the use of deliberate occlusion for enhancement and attention module to find meaningful and important features in the regions processing features with high inter-class similarity and variation. The result of this study shows that the approach has higher accuracy than recent models and, through the use of feature heatmap visualization, the possibility of approaching FER from human facial asymmetry is raised.

articleTitle: Predicting Temperature of Carbon Brick in a Blast Furnace Using Machine Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: The blast furnace is crucial for iron production in industries, with its campaign life directly impacting iron-producing costs. One significant factor affecting its lifespan is the thickness of the carbon brick which is closely related to the hearth temperature. However, the intensive smelting leads to abnormally high temperatures that erode the carbon bricks and shorten the blast furnace's lifespan. We proposed a machine-learning (ML) model for predicting the hearth temperature to solve this issue. In this study, a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) model was trained to predict the hearth temperature. The training data set originated from the operation data of one of the blast furnaces for 2761 days each of which contained 1470 features. After discussions with CSC experts, the feature number was reduced from 1470 to 360 by removing irrelevant features. Next, the top 150, 100, and 50 features related to the hearth temperature were found using the Pearson correlation coefficient. Three LSTM models were trained using three feature subsets to optimize the feature number. Furthermore, different combinations of input and output lengths were tested to optimize the model. The input lengths were 15, 30, and 45 days, and the output lengths were 1, 3, and 5 days. The last 480 days were separated from the training dataset to examine the long-term prediction of the proposed LSTM model. Since the working conditions, raw materials, and operation protocols were mutated during operation, the frequency of updating the prediction model was investigated to improve the long-term prediction accuracy. The dataset with 150 features achieved the best performance with a mean squared error (MSE) of 0.0829. For the optimal configuration, the previous 30 days' features were used to predict the temperature for the next 3 days, updated every three days. This configuration achieved the lowest MSE of 0.00939, much better than the average MSE of all groups of 0.0214. The best combination of the dataset and machine learning (ML) model was selected as a result of this study.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Applied on Cinnamon Powder Adulteration Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Cinnamon powder is an important seasoning spice frequently used in a variety of desserts. The production process of cinnamon powder is complex, which results in a relatively high price. Unscrupulous companies in the market adulterate food by using cheaper substitutes such as walnut powder or other nut powders. Apart from the problem of food fraud, the issue of allergens is even more crucial. Thus, we analyzed the adulteration of cinnamon powder through Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and using Near-Infrared Spectroscopy (NIRS). A Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) was used to detect adulteration and compare the results with those obtained by NIRS. Results indicated that the NIRS-PCA and CNN showed an accuracy rate of 99.95 and 92.80%, respectively. Finally, the proposed methods enabled quick and easy detection of adulteration in cinnamon powder, making it accessible to non-specialized personnel for testing.

articleTitle: BTDA: Automatic Solver for Math Word Problems Based On Back-Translation Data Augmentation Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: It is difficult to implement an automatic solution for math word problems (MWP) in natural language processing. In the last few years, effective results have been obtained but most of the work was to study an unknown problem. We proposed a math word problem solver BTDA based on the encoder-decoder framework with back-translation data augmentation to solve MWPs with two unknowns. In addition, we incorporated background knowledge to improve the accuracy of the solution. We built a high-quality data set HBLE with two unknown word problems. The experiment result showed that the proposed model improved the accuracy by 2.11% compared to other models.

articleTitle: Study on Diffuse Light Ratio Adjustable Device for Plant Growth Illumination
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: A lighting device for plant growth with adjustable diffuse light was designed using a full-spectrum LED with a spectral range of 380−780 nm. Based on the photophysiological characteristics of plants and their different light requirements, the device combined the diffuse reflective film and the light source leaf angle to establish three different lighting models. LIGHTTOOLS software was used to simulate and analyze the spatial illuminance uniformity, light energy utilization, and the ratio of diffuse light. The results showed that the spatial illumination uniformity became poor without diffuse reflective film, and the light energy utilization rate of the receiving surface 80 cm away from the light source was lower than 35%. The spatial illumination distribution became more uniform after adding the diffuse reflective film, and the light energy utilization rate increased to higher than 50%. By adjusting the direction and angle of the light source blade angle, the proportion of diffuse light was adjusted to meet the needs of plants for direct and diffuse lighting in different growth stages.

articleTitle: Automatic Locating Technology for Distribution Network Based on Graph Convolution Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: With the sustainable development of society, the demand for electric power energy becomes vigorous and urgent. Therefore, how to supply power stably is the key problem for power enterprises. Distribution networks connect power enterprises and end users, and its operation service quality is related to user satisfaction as well as the survival and development of power enterprises. At present, information technology changes the industry as the construction of the intelligent distribution network is deepened with a new trend of large-scale, complex, and intelligent development. Higher voltage, large transmission capacity, and frequent regional interaction lead to the advent of monitoring technology and promote the rapid development of the power distribution secondary system. Meanwhile, the probability of smart grid failure and the risk of the surge in failure data volume increase. As a result, it is necessary to design efficient, accurate, and intelligent self-extraction methods of transient fault data features for fault data identification and cleaning. In this context, we analyzed the basic technical concept of the graph convolution neural network and proposed the automatic locating technology for the distribution network based on the graph convolution neural network. The network included power distribution network topology, ChebNet encoder, and fault locating decoder. A transient fault data identification method was proposed, too based on dual graph convolution neural networks.

articleTitle: Research of Bonferroni Based on Software Algorithm for Predicting Organizational Innovation Performance
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: To improve the performance prediction of traditional organizational innovation, a prediction algorithm using the triangular fuzzy weighted Einstein Bonferroni average operator was proposed in this research. The algorithm adopted triangular fuzzy conditions for multi-attribute decisions to predict organizational innovation performance. The test results showed that the accuracy of this algorithm was improved by 30.5% compared to traditional algorithms.

articleTitle: A Low-Complexity Convolution Network for Upscale Super-Resolution Image
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: We proposed a modified architecture to reduce the computation of the ESPCN network for super-resolution generation. Based on the deep separable convolution concept, the ESPCN-based network was embedded in the 1x1 convolution layer to reduce the computations. Experiment results showed that the proposed method greatly reduces the number of parameters and computational operators, compared with the original network. The numbers were reduced by about 65% while maintaining the image quality as upscale x16. Using the DIV2K dataset for training and verification, the super-resolution image became better than that by the conventional spatial algorithms with improved PSNR values and reduced blurring.

articleTitle: Data-driven Modeling Techniques for SMA Spring
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: A data-driven modeling technique for shape memory alloy (SMA) springs was developed in this study. The conventional mathematical formula-based modeling technique requires SMA property parameter information. Thus, we developed a technique that did not require the information. A dataset was built through experiments to train the model. Based on this dataset, a regression model was also trained to estimate the force and responsiveness properties of SMA springs. Then, the SMA spring's force was modeled using a regression model's estimation results as the first-order system based on the SMA spring's properties. To validate the effectiveness and performance of the data-driven modeling method, root mean square error (RMSE) and R-squared were used. The RMSE was 91.61 g<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">f</inf> for the maximum force and 1.5 s for the time constant. The coefficient of determination was higher than 0.8. This confirmed that the regression model accurately estimated the maximum force and time constant. Finally, the validity of the suggested modeling technique was demonstrated by comparing the outcomes of the first-order system design with the real data based on the regression model findings.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of Cargo Space in Warehouse No.5 of Company A Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Many enterprises lack theoretical analysis in the establishment of a warehouse, resulting in high storage costs, operational efficiency, and others. Thus, we investigated how to improve the efficiency of the warehouse in and out of the warehouse and reduce the waste of resources in warehousing operations for warehouse No. 5 of Company A as a study case. First, the EIQ-ABC analysis was applied to analyze the goods orders in Warehouse 5 to improve the warehousing strategy. Then, a mathematical model of cargo space optimization was established for efficient cargo entry and exit and shelf stability using a genetic algorithm. The results showed that optimizing cargo space allocation using the improved multi-objective genetic algorithm improved the efficiency of access and storage and enhanced the stability of the shelves.

articleTitle: Prediction of Illegal Fundraising Behavior Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: We proposed a hybrid machine learning algorithm to predict the risk of illegal fundraising for companies. Then, the intention of criminals to disguise the company's business and financial situation can be prevented for victims who may invest in illegal fundraising. We collected risk data from 355 companies on the Internet "Enterprise Inspection" platform. With data preprocessing, combined with the features of bank statements, the features for the company's risk assessment are obtained. Then, a feature prediction model for user transaction behavior was trained using a convolutional neural network (CNN). Based on this model, the users of each company were screened, and the ratio of the number of users who complied with illegal fundraising and transactions in the company was obtained, The prediction of the risk of illegal fundraising showed a satisfactory effect.

articleTitle: Invention of Line-ChatBot: An Innovative Application of ChatGPT API and LINE Bot for Enhanced Student Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: The intelligent teaching assistant system, Line-ChatBot based on the ChatGPT API and LINE Bot is used to for homework recommendations and learning guidance. The system uses a generative language model as an accessible and cost-effective learning support tool. It has been designed to effectively comprehend and decipher difficulties in doing homework and provides tailored suggestions and guidance. Overall, Line-ChatBot is a tool for aiding students in their learning by offering an efficient, flexible, and natural learning support system. We proposed the application of this system in educational contexts for the innovation and advancement of education.

articleTitle: Design Mechanism of Power Outage Perception Prediction Model Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: The reform of the electric power system is increasingly required, and the trend of opening electricity sales and the testing market demands higher requirements for the level of power supply service and risk prevention. The application of big data technology in the electric power industry has been developed extensively in in-depth directions. It is significant to use big data technology on the related platform with data mining and analysis and achieve the scientific risk analysis of power outages. The scientific arrangement and optimal deployment of a power outage plan are also required. Therefore, we discussed the design of a power outage prediction model based on big data technology. In the construction of the big data analysis model of power outage prediction, the data classification and index for the threshold of early warning were clarified, and the optimization of the transformation plan in the distribution network was achieved to improve customer satisfaction.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Iteration and Coefficient Influence on Volume Preservation in Position-based Dynamics Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: We proposed a practical approach with position-based dynamics (PBD) to simulate the volume of a deformable body. A variety of materials were simulated using the general constraints of PBD such as stretch, bending, and volume constraints. The method for the constraint system based on PBD was fast, unconditionally stable, and controllable. However, it also had limitations and challenges that need to be addressed. The animation of the simulator required high-performance speed, therefore we used the parallelization technique of PBD since the multi-core system and massively parallel GPUs were more efficient than the naïve approach (serialize method). Since we chose Unity3D and OpenGL as the main platforms, we used the compute shader as the kernel to execute the program to solve the system of constraints. Even though the PBD-based approach was fast, the coefficients were inaccurate to maintain the object’s volume. Therefore, we demonstrated the complexity in the calculation of GPU-based PBD compared to CPU-based PBD in each different case of constraint type correlated with the coefficients. We also evaluated the effectiveness of various constraint methods within the PBD approach by comparing the error in the volume of the deformable object.

articleTitle: Application of Generative Adversarial Network Algorithm on Journaling System with Comics and Cognitive-Behavioral Theory in Social-Emotional Learning for Intermediate Elementary Students: A Pilot Study
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Like any other skill, social-emotional learning (SEL) must be practiced to be automatic. To transform the knowledge of SEL into a practical and deliverable lesson, we propose an emotion-oriented journaling system with comics for students. The system transforms the cognitive-behavioral therapy into manageable steps using comics-based storytelling and uses a method combining the term frequency-inverse document frequency (TF-IDF) method and generative adversarial network (GAN) algorithm to implement a text-to-graphics conversion. The system was tested by 36 fifth-grade students for four weeks. The experimental result shows that 41.7% of students improved their abilities of emotional recognition and self-awareness after one month of journaling on the system. Consequently, the system provides a creative and effective way for social-emotional education while speeding up the generation of visual journaling content in less time.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Impact of Learning Styles and Preferences on Vocational English Education Using Multiple Linear Regression Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Students' learning styles and preferences significantly impact their learning outcomes. Thus, the influence of students' learning styles and preferences on vocational English education was analyzed using a mathematical model. Having 50 students as research subjects, it was investigated how learning styles and preferences affected academic performance. Data were collected on learning styles, preferences, and academic achievements to analyze the data using multiple linear regression. The results indicated that students' visual and auditory learning styles substantially impacted their academic performances, while text and video preferences showed less significant influence. Therefore, teachers need to tailor personalized teaching strategies based on student’s learning styles and preferences to enhance learning outcomes. This study result offered valuable insights into vocational English education and proposed the implementation of personalized teaching methods.

articleTitle: Analyzing Enablers of Big Data Computation of New Business Students: A TISM approach
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Cultivating students’ ability to use emerging technologies for innovation is important for the reform of new business education. Technological change needs the thinking revolution essentially so the big data system is of great significance for the construction of talent training programs, implementation of competency requirements, and curriculum teaching design. This study was carried out to identify the main enablers of the big data computation (BTC) in improving the innovation capability of students majoring in business and developing a model based on the contextual relationship among the identified enablers. Initially, a systematic literature review was conducted to identify the enablers of BTC. Then, total interpretive structural modeling (TISM) was used to evolve mutual relationships among the identified 17 enablers for developing a hierarchical model. Five key driving enablers, namely data consciousness, system thinking, statistical thinking, model thinking, and analytical thinking were identified as main enablers. Image thinking played an important role in the process of data analysis and application. Suggestions were made to cultivate the student’s BTC from the following three aspects: adding system science courses in the big data specialty, increasing training opportunities for students in using tools and methods of big data management, and improving students' data literacy.

articleTitle: Underwater Unmanned Vehicles Net-Breaking Detection and Recognition System based on YOLO
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: We proposed a deep learning-based net-breaking detection and recognition system for net-breaking detection and recognition of underwater unmanned vehicles. The system was developed to assist aquaculture farmers in checking the condition of offshore fish cages. Using a Remotely Operated underwater Vehicle (ROV), underwater images were captured to identify whether the fish cage was damaged or not. The system assisted in reducing fish losses and minimizing the cost and risk of employing divers. The ROV used a single RGB camera combined with deep learning for detection. The deep learning algorithm used in the system was You Only Look Once (YOLO), which allowed the machine to learn a large number of features of various categories first and then use the resulting model to detect net damage in the fish cages.

articleTitle: Design Mechanism for the Fault Diagnosis System of Power Plant Boiler Based on Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Fault diagnosis is necessary for equipment automation and integration and allows for the rapid development of industrial society. It is necessary to study a fault diagnosis system that diagnoses, prevents, and eliminates faults. Fault prediction technologies are effective in complex industrial processes and equipment operations. We proposed a design of the fault diagnosis system of the electric field boiler using the neural network. We analyzed the process and system function of the power plant boiler and determined the basic elements in the design, including the topology structure of the neural network, boiler fault diagnosis system design, real-time communication between MATLAB and King View, and multivariate gray error neural network model.

articleTitle: Programming and Implementation of Themed Web Crawler for Equipment Procurement Prices in Vocational Colleges
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: The diversity and complexity of information on the Internet interfere with the collection of equipment procurement prices. Vocational colleges require obtaining personalized information on equipment requirements from the Internet and collecting and integrating information. Therefore, database system methods and themed web crawler methods are used using a Python-based themed web crawler. Through information acquisition and automatic keyword extraction in vocational college systems, independent analysis and query of enterprise key data are carried out on the Internet. For this, the design foundation, architecture, design and development stages, and completion process of the system are elaborated. Through practice, it has been proven that the developed themed web crawler method allowed the collection of the price data information of vocational colleges quickly, assisting in information mining work.

articleTitle: Blockchain Based E-portfolio Ecosystem
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: There have been changes in the university admissions processes in Taiwan. Reviewers focus not only on entrance exam scores but also on student's long-term learning performance. The traditional documents have been replaced by the e-portfolio system, which enables reviewers to gain a better understanding of a student's learning process, including their school grades and extracurricular activities. However, there is a lack of trust between organizations, which has prevented students from freely sharing and using their data. As a solution to this problem, we proposed a Blockchain-based e-portfolio ecosystem. The Hyperledger was used to implement this ecosystem which consisted of two channels: the certificate and award channel and the access control channel. The certificate and award channels are secured platforms for managing educational certificates and awards using two smart contracts: the certificate manager contract and the award contract. The access control channel stores and manages the authorization status of users. In addition, a trusted education unit audits the data source to ensure the credibility of the information. Overall, this proposed ecosystem solved the issues of trust and credibility in the sharing of student data. Blockchain technology provided a secure and transparent way for students to share their data with organizations and make more informed decisions during the admissions process.

articleTitle: Technical Route for Implementing Digital Voice Radio Telephony in Very High Frequency Maritime Mobile Band
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: We analyzed the feasibility of implementing wireless telephony of digital voice in the Very High Frequency (VHF) maritime mobile frequency band. The background and the attitudes of international organizations were reviewed for analyzing and comparing digital radio protocols used for VHF voice digitization, including Digital Private Mobile Radio (dPMR), Next Generation Digital Narrowband (NXDN), Digital Mobile Radio (DMR), and Trans-European Trunked Radio System (TETRA). In particular, the dPMR offshore was explored as an analog to VHF radio in Estonia. dPMR, released as an open ETSI standard, is a more popular and feasible technical route for VHF digital voice radio telephony.

articleTitle: IoT Attack Classification Based on Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) technology is widely used in various areas. Due to design constraints, IoT devices have low power consumption at a low cost. However, with increased risks to information security, IoT devices are easy targets of cyberattacks. These attacks render infrastructure devices unable to provide efficient information exchange. At the same time, the establishment of a deep learning (DL) model requires a large amount of data and takes a lot of time. Therefore, in this study, we proposed a method based on generative adversarial networks (GANs) for the classification of IoT attacks. In the original data set of 3 million records, only 50 thousand records were taken to train the GAN model. The generator automatically generated similar data and the discriminator in training, and the classification accuracy reached 80%.

articleTitle: Enhancing Parking Facility of Container Drayage in Seaports: A Study on Integrating Computer Vision and AI
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Revolutionizing seaport operations is imperative for rapid urbanization in housing, transportation, education, health, and the economy. For this, the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) and computer vision (CV) technology is required. With smart traffic monitoring and parking space distribution, smart mobility optimization is realized for intelligent cities. Seaport container transportation is also required using AI and CV technologies. Thus, we established a sustainable and efficient parking system at seaports with a comprehensive framework based on deep learning and transfer learning techniques. Through an in-depth literature review, we determined the benefits of combining AI and CV to optimize parking facility management. Then, data gathering, quality evaluation, and practical applications of CV and AI in parking spaces and lanes were conducted. The significance of AI and CV technologies in developing efficient and sustainable transportation systems was verified by enhancing container drayage efficiency in seaports. The proposed system allowed AI and CV technologies to improve traffic management, optimize parking space allocation, and streamline container movement within seaports. By using deep learning techniques, particularly transfer learning, the proposed framework accurately identified parking spaces and lanes considering the crane position. CCTV camera data were used for real-time monitoring and efficient utilization of parking spaces in the seaport. Implementation of this framework enhanced container drayage operations, improved operational efficiency, reduced congestion, and enhanced seaport management. The proposed transformative technologies are crucial for the development of sustainable and efficient transportation networks for intelligent port operations.

articleTitle: Content Extraction Model of Bilingual Loose-leaf Textbooks for Vocational Minority Students Based on Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: The semantic feature vectors of teaching texts were determined for information extraction using the characteristics of bilingual loose-leaf textbooks for ethnic minorities in vocational colleges. The corpus of bilingual loose-leaf teaching was trained in neural networks to extract template semantic feature vectors independently. Then, the required data was extracted in task modules. In this method, lexical analysis was not necessary owing to its relatively fine information processing and granularity. The algorithm proposed in this study showed an improved accuracy upto 30.5% compared to those of traditional algorithms. It also had the adaptability to standardize language semantic elements and structures.

articleTitle: Mixed Dining: Enhancing Social Interaction of Elderly Individuals Living Alone with Smart Dining Environment and Wearable MR
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: The aging population is an issue in many countries with a substantial proportion of the elderly living alone. Social isolation and loneliness represent significant challenges for the elderly, impacting their mental, emotional, and physical well-being. For this problem, we proposed Mixed Dining, an innovative system that integrated a smart dining environment with wearable MR (MR) devices to encourage social engagement and enhance the overall quality of life for the elderly. Mixed Dining combined ambient intelligence sensors and Internet of Things (IoT) devices to create a personalized and interactive dining environment. The wearable mixed reality (MR) device seamlessly was integrated into the smart dining environment, providing real-time holographic interactions with friends, family members, or even virtual companions during mealtime. The system was designed to detect the user's emotional state and adjust the experience accordingly, promoting a more engaging and emotionally supportive dining experience, enabling the elderly to engage in social interactions, access information, and receive assistance during meals through intuitive and user-friendly interaction. The Mixed Dining represented a promising solution for enhancing the social interaction of the elderly living alone.

articleTitle: Brain Study to Understand Destructive Alzheimer Disease and Artificial Intelligence (AI) Technology In Art Creation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: The dilemma created by the new technology forms a world of metaverse with the question of ‘Does modern life violate the basic needs of human physiology and psychology?’ To better understand the culprit acts of human memory, it is necessary to expose the brain to challenges so that the brain can be hyperalerted to avoid Alzheimer’s disease. Using visual arts, neurodegenerative disorders and diseases could be better understood.

articleTitle: Applying Deep Reinforcement Learning for Self-organizing Network Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Inefficient resource allocation and unstable connection quality for mobile devices are the primary challenges of Self-Organizing Networks (SON). Frequent handovers between base stations result in a network burden imbalance. In contrast, unstable connection quality causes disconnection or signal interference between mobile devices and base stations, influencing network performance and reliability. In recent years, wireless communication technology has extensively used Reinforcement Learning (RL) to obtain the optimal strategy through continuous interaction between agents and their environments. Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) is based on Deep Neural Networks (DNN) to handle increasingly complex network situations. We proposed a SON architecture based on DRL in response to the aforementioned challenges. We described how the agent learns the optimal parameter settings through training based on various network scenarios to develop handover strategies and enhance overall network performance and resource utilization. The proposed framework can be applied to the present Fifth Generation (5G) network.

articleTitle: Research on Relationship Between Bullet Screen Attributes in Medical Popular Science Videos and The audience’s cognitive load
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: This article aims to explore the relationship between bullet screen attributes in medical popular science videos and the audience’s cognitive load. The evaluation indicators for cognitive load included subjects' blink frequency, gaze count, and response to task completion in eye-tracking experiments. The connection between the audience’s cognitive load and the opacity and speed attributes of bullet screens in popular science videos was investigated, and the impact of different bullet screen attributes on the audience’s cognitive load was explored. By analyzing the relationship between attributes such as bullet screen content, density, speed, and the audience’s cognitive load in watching medical science videos, the attention allocation patterns of the audience towards bullet screens and video content were analyzed using eye-tracking technology. Experimental results indicated that the opacity of bullet screens impacted cognitive load significantly with the lowest cognitive load of audiences. The speed of bullet screens also affected the audience’s cognitive load with slower speeds resulting in a less cognitive impact and lower cognitive load.

articleTitle: Robust Client Selection Based Secure Collaborative Learning Algorithm for Pneumonia Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: The challenge for artificial intelligence (AI)-based biomedical systems is to ensure privacy and security when sharing sensitive medical data. While collaborative learning offers a solution by allowing model exchange and enabling distributed data analysis, the risk of model poisoning, where malicious participants inject false or manipulated model updates, can lead to potential degradation of overall learning performance. To solve this issue, we proposed a Client Selection Secure Collaborative Learning (CSSCL) algorithm to ensure robust collaborative learning in a hybrid real-time AI-enabled biomedical system while preserving data and model privacy. Specifically, we used Minkowsky similarity as a metric to assess the quality of local models, filter out the manipulated models, and exclude them from the aggregation process. The qualified models related to the corresponding clients were selected, resulting in a reliable aggregated model. In the empirical evaluation of the proposed CSSCL algorithm, the performance metrics showed a remarkable improvement in the final training accuracy. In particular, the proposed method significantly increased the final training accuracy, ranging from 2 to 30% for attack scenarios from 20 to 50%. In addition, the proposed method was evaluated in a specific application scenario, namely pneumonia detection, and provided comparably favorable results. The experiment results showed that the CSSCL-based method had notable potential in various application scenarios. The result of this study presented a significant contribution to medical diagnostic systems for future research.

articleTitle: Development of Machine Learning Based Real-Time Squat Training Feedback System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Regular exercise is crucial for maintaining good health, as it promotes muscle growth and helps prevent cardiovascular diseases. Among various forms of exercise, multi-joint exercises are considered the most effective for individuals with limited time availability. However, unsupervised multi-joint exercises may be ineffective and can even lead to injuries. Hence, technological intervention during the workout is required to improve the quality and safety of the training when supervisors are unavailable. Therefore, an automatic recording system for squats with prompt feedback is proposed in this study. Users could analyze their movements using this system and receive suggestions through the screen to improve their form and perform squats correctly even when the coach is not around. To provide feedback immediately, the input features of the machine learning model had to be simple and accurate. Hence, instead of using the entire video, only three critical features were selected in this study to train the machine learning model. The first feature was the angle of the body and thigh (BT), and the second feature was the backward bending of the foot (Dorsiflexion, DF). The third feature was bar-shift (BS), which is the deviation between the barbell and virtual center line (extending from the middle of the ankle and forefoot). In this study, 1826 squats from 54 subjects were successfully recorded and labeled to 11 different conditions. The recorded features were processed to create six datasets. Then, five machine-learning architectures, including Random Forest, XGBoost, 1D-CNN, LSTM, and LSTNet, were trained on different combinations of datasets to find the optimized model. Among them, Random Forest showed the best accuracy in predicting the quality of the squat (72.6%) and recognizing the functional disabilities that led to poor squatting. Finally, a real-time squat training feedback system was demonstrated and examined. Three trainers with an advanced barbell squat technique were asked to perform 10 good squats and 10 questionable squats. The proposed system successfully recorded 54 out of 60 squats, and the accuracy of rating the squat was 55.5%.

articleTitle: A Design of IoT-based Platform for Monitoring Environmental Factors Affecting Plant Growth
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: In response to the future food shortest crisis, the World Government Summit in 2018 released a report entitled "Agriculture 4.0 - The Future of Agricultural Technology" to describe the application of emerging Industry 4.0 technologies to agriculture such as the Internet of Things (IoT), big data analytics, and smart sensors. Environmental factors are known to affect plant growth include light, temperature, water, humidity and nutrition. Thus, it's very important to understand how those factors affect plant growth and development. A wireless IoT monitoring platform is proposed in this paper to collect four environmental data for the study of factors affecting soil water evaporation. It is achieved by the development of wireless sensor network (WSN) modules to cope with different types of sensor for temperature, humidity, sun-light and water tension. First, four types of environmental data are collected through the interface designed in the proposed WSN module. The collected data is then uploaded to the cloud database via a 2G/3G/4G LTE router. Finally, the code MySQL is employed for the data management and analysis while code MATLAB is used for data visualization to facilitate analysis and comparison. A comparison of the collected information and the data obtained from the Hsinchu Weather Station, Central Weather Bureau (CWB), Taiwan, R.O.C. is obtained to demonstrate the success of the proposed design.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Dark-Channel Prior Dehazing Algorithm Based on STM32
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: To solve the problems caused by low contrast and unclear details in existing defogging algorithms, a dark channel prior adaptive defogging algorithm based on STM32 was proposed in this study. The algorithm improved the original defogging model with an adaptive threshold to adjust the transmission rate. The proposed algorithm avoided the possibility of being detected as white areas, reduced deviation, and effectively saved the required computing resources. At the same time, the post-defogging image was optimized according to the edge characteristics of the image. In the experiment, images with different brightness and complexity were processed by the proposed algorithm for better defogging effects in different scenes. Edge details were obtained, too with better defogging effects. The proposed algorithm laid a foundation for later video defogging.

articleTitle: Improving the Structural Design of Flow Batteries Using Light-curable 3D Printing Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Owing to the increasing global demand for energy storage, Redox Flow Battery (RFB) has become popular for large-scale energy storage. To reduce costs and time for R&D, we used light-curable 3D printing technology to manufacture flow field frames and components by applying technology related to RFB. As a result, a low-cost RFB based on cerium/iron electrolyte and TiO2-MnO2-modified electrodes was successfully fabricated. This result provides a basis for the development cycle and cost of RFBs.

articleTitle: Neural Network-based Modeling or Boiler Combustion Control System for Power Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: The numerous factors affecting combustion complicate the combustion process of the power generation boiler. In supervising the combustion process of the boiler, special attention needs to be paid to the characteristics of the factory and the combustion of the boiler. In the improvement of the power boiler system, it is useful to realize the automatic control and intelligent operation of the boiler. To understand the boiler factory characteristics, fuel characteristics, and other parameters and to clarify the complex coupling relationship between the parameters, an improved design of the combustion control of the boiler is required. Therefore, we established the combustion control system to realize the nonlinear identification of the combustion process of the boiler using the nonlinear learning ability of the neural network. We proposed the modeling mechanism of a power boiler combustion control system. We analyzed the working principle of the boiler combustion system and the combustion process. We tested the model by preprocessing and analyzing the combustion optimization using input and output data to optimize the system architecture design.

articleTitle: ShuffleSR: Image Deepfake Detection Using Shuffle Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: We proposed an improved method based on the Shuffle Transformer for facial forgery detection. The method incorporated SE (Squeeze-and-Excitation) and ROI (Region of Interest) modules. By introducing the SE module, the network's channel attention capability was enhanced and enabled the model to focus more on important feature channels. Meanwhile, the ROI module was employed to extract the region of interest corresponding to the face, enabling the network to concentrate on processing facial regions. The performance of facial forgery detection was improved as a result. Evaluations were conducted on the DFDC dataset and a custom dataset containing various forgery algorithms. The results demonstrated that the enhanced Shuffle Transformer achieved significant performance improvements in facial forgery detection and exhibited better robustness and generalization capabilities while excelling across different forgery algorithms.

articleTitle: Clustering Study on Behavioral Characteristics of Physical Exercise Culture Based on ANT Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Using background subtraction technology, the binary images of students' bodies in physical exercise were obtained. By calculating image moments, the centroid of a student's body was calculated, and centroid velocity features were obtained by combining local binary mode histogram features and the feature vectors of the student's physical exercise behavior. A clustering model was constructed with the ant colony algorithm in which the consistency between feature vectors was used to cluster students' physical exercise behavior. In order to address the shortcomings of low convergence efficiency and potential stagnation in the ant colony algorithm, the pheromone update method and ant selection path method were optimized. The optimization method improved the performance of the algorithm. The results showed that the proposed method accurately extracted the characteristics of students' physical exercise behavior and produced clustering results with a 15% higher accuracy than traditional algorithms.

articleTitle: Rear Wheel Steering System for Vehicles Using Axial Flux Permanent Motor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Focusing on a rear-wheel steering (RWS) system with an integrated structure combining a planetary gear and an Axial Flux Permanent Magnet (AFPM) motor. The RWS system reduces the turning radius of the vehicle and enhances driving stability. Conventional RWS systems consist of separate components, including the steering motor, sensors, and gears. Specifically, the steering motor generates the torque to turn the wheels. A failure of the steering motor compromises driving safety and makes steering operation difficult. To overcome these issues, we proposed an integrated steering system structure that combines an AFPM motor with a planetary gear instead of the RFPM (Radial Flux Permanent Magnet) motor. In this study, a rear-wheel steering system with an integrated structure combining a planetary gear and an AFPM motor was applied, and its performance was evaluated through simulations. In the proposed steering system, the ball screw of the steering shaft was combined with the planetary gear of the AFPM motor. The movement of the ball screw generated the rotation of the wheels. The steering system incorporating the proposed AFPM motor with two stators showed improvements in torque and system redundancy compared to the steering system using the RFPM motor. Additionally, by applying two stators compared to one stator in the conventional RFPM motor, the proposed steering system did not lose the rear-wheel steering function even if one stator failed. The proposed system improved system redundancy and torque while enhancing driving stability in the event of a failure. Further validation of the proposed system requires the fabrication of an actual model and additional analysis.

articleTitle: Efficient Routing in SDN using Minimum Bottleneck Spanning Tree
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Software-defined networking (SDN) decouples control and data planes of network devices to manage network services and determine forwarding paths in a centralized manner. In order to reduce the occurrence of path rerouting, we proposed a routing scheme to generate both default and alternative paths based on the minimum bottleneck spanning tree (MBST). With the proposed routing algorithm, routing paths was evenly distributed to different links, and redundant path rerouting was avoided. The experimental results demonstrated that the proposed scheme reduced the number of path-rerouting occurrences. The proposed scheme balanced link loads effectively.

articleTitle: Breathing+: A Game-based System for Enhancing Respiratory Training and Motivation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Breathing difficulties, such as shortness of breath or rapid breathing, can significantly harm health and diminish the quality of life. Breathing exercises are widely recognized for their effectiveness in resolving such difficulties. They increase lung function, ease discomfort, and alleviate stress. However, current breathing-assisted methods, such as the incentive spirometer, do not accurately track the duration and frequency of training despite their advantages. Furthermore, the process of performing breathing exercises is tedious over time, making users feel bored and reducing their motivation. Thus, we presented Breathing+, a breathing video game designed to address these limitations by providing a series of game challenges. Breathing+ incorporated sensors to detect breathing signals and provided users with real-time feedback on a screen. According to the experimental results, Breathing+ achieved a breathing recognition accuracy of 95%. In addition, the response time to the user’s breathing was around 0.23 s.

articleTitle: Efficient Transmission Based on Constrained Energy Algorithm for Multiple Wireless Body Area Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: We developed a heuristic algorithm with constrained energy for multiple users in multiple wireless area networks (WSNs). On the human body, many body sensors were attached to transmit biomedical data in WSN. In the traditional method, a body sensor transmits biomedical information to the group coordinate node with full transmitting energy. However, energy consumption affects the efficient delivery of sense signals which downgrades system performance. Therefore, we implemented an energy balance mechanism to enhance the efficient delivery of the signals with the constraint of transmitting energy. We developed the optimization model with the dynamic deployment method and implemented experimental analysis to prove that the optimization model distinguished significant improvement in packet transmitting throughput, packet transmitting delay, drop ratio of packet delivery, power consumption of transmitting the packet, and network lifetime.

articleTitle: Method for Detecting Student Classroom Learning Fatigue Based on Optical and Infrared Images
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: In classroom teaching, it is important for teachers to notice promptly the learning fatigue lever of students for the improvement of teaching quality. The fatigue of learners in classroom learning reflects their interest in learning, the difficulty of knowledge understanding, and the degree of mastery of knowledge. Thus, we developed an optical and infrared image fusion system to describe the fatigue level of students in the classroom using face segmentation technology and eye area positioning technology in image processing. In this system, the student's facial image was taken with a color lens and an infrared lens installed about 50 cm in front of the desk. Changes in marks on the student's face and segments in the eye area were detected by calculating eye aspect ratio, eye closure time, blink rate, and color. By fusing optical and infrared images, the color and infrared features were detected according to the change in intensity of light. The fusion matrix was created to estimate the impact of the light on fatigue detection. The experiment results verified a high accuracy in the detection of student fatigue. After detecting the degree of fatigue of students, teachers can adjust teaching content or teaching methods to maximize the quality of classroom teaching.

articleTitle: Investigation of Thermal Management and Control System of Lithium-Ion Battery Based on Multiphysics Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Spontaneous thermal runaway has become a significant issue for thermal management and control systems during the operation of lithium-ion batteries recently. Therefore, we discussed the heat distribution of lithium-ion batteries under different high discharge rates. Firstly, the lithium-ion batteries were tested to obtain the properties of electrochemical and thermal behavior at different discharge rates. One-dimensional electrochemical coupling three-dimensional heat transfer models was established by using numerical simulation commercial software. The simulation results were compared with the experimental results to verify the feasibility of the model. Finally, the electrochemical characteristics were incorporated into the three-dimensional model, and the heat distribution profile generated by the batteries connected in series and parallel was simulated to figure out the critical temperature when the thermal runaway was triggered under different C-rates.

articleTitle: Optimization Algorithm and Simulation of Cold Chain Preservation Logistics Delivery Path Based on Continuous Linear Function
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: In response to the uncertain demand for fresh products from customers, a continuous linear function equation was used to set the uncertain demand at the delivery point as a normal distribution form. An expected time window and an acceptable time window were defined to set the minimum delivery cost as the objective function for path optimization. A delivery path optimization model for the cold chain was proposed as a result. The simulation results showed that the algorithm proposed in this study showed 50.8% higher accuracy than the other models without optimization.

articleTitle: Assessment of Impact on Navigation Safety in the Taiwan Strait during China's Naval Blockade Exercise
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: After the Speaker of the United States House of Representatives, Nancy Pelosi's visit to Taiwan in early August 2022, China immediately conducted large-scale military exercises and implemented a maritime blockade in the surrounding waters of Taiwan. Although the military drill was unexpected, the Chinese side had issued prior notifications of multiple restricted areas. The blockade areas in the Taiwan Strait are crucial international shipping routes. This blockade forced vessels to reroute and avoid the prohibited zone, affecting the safety of navigation in the Taiwan Strait. Therefore, we evaluated the impact of the maritime blockade on the safety of navigation in the northeast sea area of Taiwan, collecting Automatic Identification System (AIS) information on ships before and after the military exercise and using relevant technologies such as databases and Geographic Information Systems (GIS) to draw Electronic Navigational Charts (ENC). We also conducted a simulated analysis of ship collision risk for the new route after the changes. The military exercise's maritime blockade significantly increased the navigational risk of the Taiwan Strait.

articleTitle: Unsupervised Image-to-Image Translation Based on Bidirectional Style Transfer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Image-to-image translation (I2I) is an image synthesis technique to map a source image to the style of the target domain while preserving its content information. Existing image-to-image translation study results showed excellent image synthesis performance using generative adversarial network (GAN) based models, but they are not capable of efficiently handling the style of the target domain. To overcome this limitation, a bidirectional style transfer network has been developed to perform image synthesis by intersecting images of two domains with each other's styles, but the type of applicable dataset is limited due to supervised learning-based training. We proposed an unsupervised image-to-image translation method by employing a bidirectional style transfer network with a cyclic collaborative loss to train the model. Experimental results showed that the proposed network accurately reflected the style of the target domain in the image synthesis task.

articleTitle: Computer-aided Design of Spring-loaded Bayonet Wheels Based on Gear Meshing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: With the increasing demand for vertical transportation due to the need for a better quality of life and the exacerbation of population aging, we proposed a computer-aided design for a spring buckle wheel with gear and rack meshing. The design had the advantages of wheel-type and track-type wheels. The outer periphery of the wheel had six identical arc segments with retractable link rods with external springs between each module and the central axis for support. The axle was equipped with a self-locking device for the inward buckle climbing of modules and steps and the fixed self-locking transformation to be used on flat ground. By using computer-aided design, weak climbing stability and poor adaptability were solved. Solidworks software was used to model and simulate the design of the wheel. The stability and adaptability of the wheel were tested based on the position of the center of mass and linear velocity in climbing and on flat ground. The results showed that bumpiness was felt in climbing when the wheel contacted the steps, but after that, the linear velocity remained almost constant, and the curve of the center of mass position was smooth. This indicated strong stability in climbing. On flat ground, the linear velocity was constant, indicating that after the modules of the spring buckle were self-locked, the wheels had no compression or inward buckling. Flexible switching was allowed between climbing and moving on flat ground. Climbing was controlled for different compressions, showing strong adaptability to steps of different sizes

articleTitle: Design Framework for IoT Planting System: Acceptance and User Experience of Elderly Living Alone
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: In an aging society, the Internet of Things (IoT) is applied in many aspects of the daily life of the elderly living alone to improve their independence and lessen unaccompanied loneliness. We developed a remote-control technology using the IoT system to increase the awareness of the elderly. Yet, the IoT system has not been frequently employed as it has problems. Thus, we designed and refined the existing system to help the elderly. Based on the evaluation of user experience, we designed a framework for the IoT system. The developed system can be used for the emotional needs of the elderly living alone by improving their acceptance and experience through multi-modal human-computer interaction.

articleTitle: Reducing Traffic Congestion caused by Frame Replication and Elimination for Reliability in zonal-based In-Vehicle Network Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: The complexities of vehicle networks continue to increase as the number of electronic control units (ECUs) in vehicles increases. There are various issues caused by the data generated by such many ECUs. Especially, it is essential to prevent the loss of important data during transmission processes. The Ethernet-based time-sensitive networking (TSN) standards have been standardized to meet the requirements of various industries. Among TSN standards, IEEE 802.1CB is established to prevent packet loss that occurs during transmission by redundant transmission of packets through multipaths called frame replication and elimination for reliability (FRER). However, applying FRER to an actual network is not an easy task. Thus, we proposed a method to optimize the efficient utilization of resources wasted at nodes due to FRER. In the proposed method, after a receiver receives a packet with an FRER header, it transmitted a reply packet to the connected controllers in an in-vehicle network (IVN). Then, Controllers confirmed that the transmission processes were complete and avoided sending a duplicated packet to the receiver. To evaluate the performance of the proposed method, we designed a zonal-based IVN architecture and generated a simulator. The simulation results demonstrated that the proposed method more effectively used network resources in central processing unit (CPU) than FRER.

articleTitle: Recognition Algorithm of Financial Data Validity of Listed Enterprises Based on Classification Regression Decision Tree
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Using financial parameters, a classification regression tree system was built to identify the effectiveness of enterprise accounting information. The test result showed that the accuracy of the algorithm in identifying enterprises with effective accounting information was higher than 93%, and the second type of failure rate was limited to 20%. Empirical research also showed that enterprises with retained profits accounting for less than 3% of their net assets were more likely to discover the reliability of accounting information. Finally, data analysis was conducted to test this result, proving that its recognition function was satisfactory.

Author Keywords: identification of the effectiveness of financial information

articleTitle: Analysis of Smart Building System: Risks, Threats, and Standards
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Sustainable development goals (SDGs) balance social, economic, and environmental sustainability. The United Nations predicts that 68% of the world's population will live in cities by 2050. The energy efficiency, availability, safety, and accessibility of space increase the need for high-rise buildings. The International Energy Agency predicts there will be 830 hundred million Internet of Things (IoT) devices and sensors by 2024, assist optimal decision-making and help cities automatically adjust to form a complex IoT environment. With the rapid development of technologies, the risks and challenges faced by issues such as big data security, software and hardware protection, disaster prevention and rescue, and personal safety have also changed from single to complex. Taking smart building as the subject, we discuss related risks, standards, and technologies to propose a risk framework covering information communication, disaster prevention, system integration, and facility management. Provide solutions to achieve smart, safety, and sustainability goal.

articleTitle: Development of Smart Casting System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Robots have been used for more than half a century. If the computer visions are integrated with the robots, the functions improve considerably for the detection of color, shape, and position and the inspection of the defects of parts. However, these applications are used for solid objects, and the research on liquid objects is scarce. Moreover, computer vision is not enough for developing an automated manufacturing system. Thus, we developed an automated casting system using robotic arms, computer vision, and weight sensors. The developed system consisted of a six-axis robotic arm, an electric gripper, computer vision modules, weight sensors and others. The control console and the human-machine-interface (HMI) of the system were operated with LabVIEW. The operation of the system starts with inputting the required conditions and collecting the weight of the cylinder measured by the sensors. The position of the casting mold was detected by computer vision modules. Then, the robotic arm moved for casting. In casting, the information on the weight was fed from the sensors to keep the casting system stable. The developed system can be applied to the manufacturing industry.

articleTitle: VLSI Implementation of RISC-V MCU with a variable stage pipeline
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Based on the RISC-V RV32IM instruction set architecture and the variable-length pipeline architecture design, we researched how to reduce the execution time of instructions. An in-order dispatch, out-of-order writeback" dispatch strategy was adopted to increase the performance of the microcontroller unit (MCU). Since the execution time of each instruction in the MCU is not the same, using a general five-layer pipeline for the design results in an excessively long execution time due to the long instructions. Therefore, we proposed a variable-length pipeline architecture based on the Hummingbird E200 architecture so that the MCU can use different pipeline lengths when executing different instructions. Due to the dispatch mechanism designed by the proposed pipeline architecture, it was not necessary to execute the instructions at the pipeline stages unrelated to their functions, thereby speeding up the completion of the instructions. When designing the pipeline architecture, we focused on the "multiplication/division" operation to execute in the execution stage of the MCU and cut the pipeline to shorten the execution time of the pipeline stage. The proposed MCU adopted an out-of-order write-back method so that instructions without data dependencies could be written back in sequence without waiting for each other, further improving system performance. The TSMC’s 0.18 μm process was used to implement this chip with the "pipeline" and "out-of-order writeback" architecture proposed in this research. Its operating clock was 120 MHz. In the same 0.18 μm process, the Hummingbird E200’s operating clock was 50MHz.

articleTitle: FPGA Design of RISC-V MCU Collaborative Industrial Printer Control System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: The industrial printer control system was proposed in this research with a hardware architecture to support four print heads simultaneously. The system quickly and accurately calculated the printing distance and time of inkjet printing to achieve high-quality printing effects. In terms of vertical resolution, the system provided options such as 600, 300, 150, and 75 DPI. Horizontally, the system performed various DPI printing by detecting and calculating the speed of the rotary encoder. Following high-quality printing standards, the printing performance of industrial printers was enhanced, and the fastest printing speed reached 943 m/min. This industrial printer control system was implemented on an Altera FPGA incorporating the design of a reduced instruction set computer-V (RISC-V) microcontroller unit (MCU) [2] and an in-circuit debugger (ICD). The RISC-V MCU has a three-stage pipeline architecture to improve performance through parallel processing. The design was streamlined and modular to reduce costs, and an EBI BUS was added to communicate with peripheral devices. The ICD was used to monitor the status of the printing control system at any time and display the printing situation on the software platform. These comprehensive functions allowed industrial printers to have more complete functions and expandability. Using the SystemVerilog hardware description language, ModelSim’s HDL simulation software was modified and tested. The functionality was verified through the field-programmable gate array (FPGA) program to ensure that it’s correct. The implementation results can achieve the functions of an industrial printer control system with a speed of 100MHz.

articleTitle: Brand Product Recognition Model of Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises Based on AI Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: To overcome the issue of insufficient accuracy in product selection methods used by small and medium-sized enterprises, the behavior and evaluation process of enterprise consumers were investigated. Statistics were analyzed to determine the level of consumer identification with commodity products and their level of engagement. The NDSC method was then employed to cluster consumers, followed by the use of the TOP-10 method for neighbor matching. Consequently, a product list for enterprise consumers was generated based on these neighbor-matching relationships. The results demonstrated that the algorithm exhibited superior accuracy, recall, and F-value compared to collaborative filtering algorithms and fusion algorithms.

articleTitle: Study on Quality Evaluation Model of Dialect English Translation Publicity Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: To improve the automatic evaluation of English translation of dialects, the intelligent algorithm based on machine learning is the most feasible solution.
