In this study, in-depth research was conducted on the translation law and characteristics of the English translation of dialects to construct a translation evaluation index system based on variable characteristics. Python and other language platforms were used to filter and preprocess Stanford Parser, natural language toolkit (NLTK), and other method packages. Feature codes and degrees were obtained by simulating the vector space model (VSM) to train the original random forest (RF) and analytical hierarchical process (AHP)-RF algorithm for evaluation and big data analysis. The test results showed that the AHP of the grey correlation method and RF algorithm was more effective than other methods. Compared with the other four machine learning translations, human translation showed higher evaluation results and fewer analysis errors. The evaluation was consistent with the actual compilation.

articleTitle: Neural Network-based Genetic Algorithm for Autonomous Boat Pathfinding
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Genetic algorithms become widely used in various optimization as a nature-inspired algorithm. This biological-based algorithm includes three genetic operators: selection, crossover or recombination, and mutation. In this study, the genetic operator processed neural network parameters, including the weight and bias. Three-ray sensors with different directions input data into the neural network. We applied the method to autonomous boats for pathfinding responding to dynamic environment challenges. Generally, autonomous boats face difficulty in path-finding in dynamic environments. To evaluate the method, we experimented with the scenario of the static and dynamic environment (with wave surface) in a three-dimensional simulation platform. The hyperparameter of layer number and mutation rate variation were used. The results showed that the method was useful in pathfinding in static and dynamic environments.

articleTitle: Differentiated Service for Distributed Queuing MAC Protocol in 5G cellular IoT Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: A distributed-queuing medium access control protocol was proposed based on a differentiated service (DSMAC) for 5G cellular IoT networks. In the proposed DSMAC protocol, IoT nodes selected a specified time slot based on the differentiated service and then sent information on the data request control frame to the IoT head in the contention window. The time slot in the contention window was divided based on differentiated service levels according to the priority of data to be transmitted. The proposed DSMAC protocol reduced collision probability and the medium access control (MAC) delay caused by the differentiated data transmission. Furthermore, high throughput was achieved owing to distributed queuing based on the differentiated data transmission mechanism. A comparison of the proposed DSMAC protocol with traditional distributed-queuing MAC protocols revealed that the DSMAC protocol performed better in 5G cellular IoT networks.

articleTitle: Design of a Hybrid In-Vehicle Network Architecture Combining Zonal and Domain Architectures for Future Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: There has been an increase in the number of electronic control units (ECUs) installed in vehicles with the increasing demand for emerging vehicular technologies such as advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS) and vehicle-to-everything (V2X). This causes issues in increasing the length and weight of wiring harnesses and the complexity of the network. To resolve these issues, domain-based in-vehicle network (IVN) architecture (DIA) is being adopted in vehicles. However, the DIA is unable to fully resolve the issues. As a solution, research on zonal-based IVN architecture (ZIA) has been widely conducted along with Ethernet-based time-sensitive networking (TSN) concurrently. However, there are several technical challenges in transitioning from DIA to ZIA. Such a transition requires a completely new system design. This drastic technological change may impose a burden so it may be difficult for companies to accommodate. To alleviate these burdens, we proposed a hybrid IVN architecture (HIA) with TSN, combining zonal and domain architectures. To validate the performance of the proposed HIA, we implemented DIA and HIA simulators using the OMNeT++ network simulator and compared E2E delays and the total length of the wiring harnesses. The results revealed that HIA reduced 20.4% of the shorter end-to-end (E2E) delay and reduced 21.2% of the total length of the wiring harness compared to DIA. It was demonstrated that HIA was superior to DIA based on the obtained results.

articleTitle: Distributed Relay Selection with Reduced Modulation-Order Signal Forwarding and Energy Harvesting
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: We proposed a new relay-selection (RS) scheme that operates in a completely distributed manner without the need for any channel state information at the transmitter (CSIT). Based on the information extracted from the received signals sent by the source, an antenna at the selected relay is used to forward signals. Notably, the modulation order of the forwarded symbols was reduced, which benefits the end-to-end error-rate performance. The results showed that in several scenarios, this distributed RS (D-RS) provides a lower error rate than the network with one relay, even using CSIT for enhancing the transmit diversity. Thanks to the use of the D-RS, we demonstrated that the unselected relays harvest radio-frequency energy from the forwarded signals toenergize the relay operation and prolong the lifetime of the network.

articleTitle: Construction Robot Application Barrier Factor Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: To improve the level of intelligent construction in China, promote the application of construction robots, and solve the problems of the low application rate of construction robots and limited substantive progress, obstacle factors in the application of construction robots were researched based on relevant literature. Factors were grouped into 4 categories using the Interpretative Structural Model (ISM). The lack of talent in the related research was the main influencing factor. The driving forces and degree of dependence between various influencing factors were explored with the cross-influence matrix multiplication method (MICMAC). The result helped identify the important obstacle factors in the application of construction robots and provided relevant references for the promotion and application of the robots.

articleTitle: Study on E-commerce Platform by Recommendation Algorithm Based on Collaborative Filtering Principle
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: To overcome data sparsity and expansion caused by the traditional collaborative filtering model in the e-commerce platform, we proposed a recommendation algorithm for the online e-commerce platform. The algorithm allowed data differentiation with the double clustering method and integrated the characteristics of customers based on project-based collaborative filtering. The efficiency was improved and recommendation quality was satisfactory with an accuracy rate of 90.3% compared with other recommendation models.

articleTitle: Security Assessment of Low Earth Orbit (LEO) with Software-Defined Networking (SDN) Structure
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: The Software-defined networking (SDN) is integrated into Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite for flexible and agile operation. This cutting-edge convergence has security risks that require detailed assessment. These security challenges include software vulnerabilities, compromised centralized control, security policies, open interfaces and APIs, protocol security, and authentication and authorization mechanisms. Therefore, we proposed an approach based on the Secure Software Development Life Cycle (SSDLC) to analyze and assess the security risk assessment of the LEO-SDN architecture. The security issues were investigated for LEO satellites with the SDN framework. The security of the software, the control mechanisms of SDN, and the inherent dynamics of LEO satellite networks were then assessed. The open interfaces in SDN and the communication protocol security between SDN and LEO were suggested.

articleTitle: Improving Accuracy of Pseudo-LiDAR for 3D Object Detection by Accurate Depth Estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: With the advancement of autonomous driving technology, traditional 2D object detection approaches no longer fulfill the Safety of The Intended Functionality (SOTIF) standards. LiDAR sensors are efficient in giving precise point cloud information for accurate and reliable 3D object detection. Alternative sensors also are researched by researchers if they have lower costs but are limited in environmental circumstances. Notably, pseudo-LiDAR-based monocular 3D object detection has emerged as a viable option, as it generates a depth map from an RGB picture before translating it into a point cloud for 3D object detection. However, because the majority of depth estimation algorithms do not account for the loss of boundary information during feature extraction processing, depth artifacts occur in the periphery of objects in the depth map. These artifacts introduce long-tail problems in pseudo-LiDAR data, undermining the accuracy of 3D object detection. Therefore, we suggested a depth estimation method using Laplacian pyramid-based depth residuals to correctly capture object depth bounds. This improved the estimate and revised the depth map, which was converted into pseudo-LiDAR point cloud data. The pseudo-LiDAR was then used to recognize 3D objects. The proposed method, in particular, significantly mitigated the common border Long-tail problems in pseudo-LiDAR data, hence improving the precision of 3D object detection. Experiment validations demonstrated the method's efficiency and enhanced performance to improve the reliability of autonomous driving systems.

articleTitle: Reset-based Recovery Mechanism through Entropy Cutoff to Counter BUS-OFF Attacks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Internal communication for healthy working systems is crucial. A controller area network (CAN) is such a tool for vehicles. We proposed a method to respond to BUS-OFF attacks that happen either due to malicious message injection or through firmware overrides in the CAN controller. The proposed entropy-based BUS-OFF attack detection impacts the states in which the compromised CAN controller operates.

articleTitle: Energy Saving Solution for Welding Process: A SME Case Study of Fume Extractor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: In the manufacturing industry, welding is commonly used for the metal joining process. However, welding yields fume, which is toxic and dangerous for workers regarding health issues. Many companies install fume extractors to reduce these risks to eliminate fume from the working environment. As it effectively removes fume, fume extractors are used all the time during office hours. It is wasteful of electricity, especially during non-operational time. This is inefficient, too, and is called vampire power due to wasted electrical energy. To save energy, researchers proposed an energy-saving solution to modify the fume extractor by implementing an automation system that is integrated with the MIG welding machine and analyzing its impact on energy savings. In this study, the fume extractor was analyzed for its effects. The conceptual design was created for a fume extractor integrated with a MIG welding machine using a relay and a timer. The mechanism of the fume extractor was based on the chain reaction between the welding gun at standby and active modes. When the welding gun was used, the welding machine turned on the fume extractor. To turn it off, there was a 30-s delay. The fume extractor was tested in a company in Indonesia. The result demonstrated a significant reduction in electricity consumption, resulting in lower operational costs and decreased CO2 emissions. The proposed solution was feasible and cost-effective for small and medium companies that use MIG welding and fume extractors.

articleTitle: Effect of Pressure Change on the Performance of Supercharged Diesel Engine by Computer Simulation System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: To understand the particularity of the environment in the plateau region in the working state of the engine, we simulated the environmental characteristics with the help of an experimental platform. By collecting detailed data on the dynamic performance and starting performance of an engine under different plateau conditions, the law of the performance change of the supercharged engine was investigated with the change of air pressure. The result of this study provided an explanation of the use of vehicles in plateau areas.

articleTitle: A Fault Detection Method of Photovoltaic Cells Based on BP Neural Network Training for Current Trend
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: The faults of the photovoltaic (PV) system have been researched extensively as they seriously affect the efficiency of the PV cells and cause a fire in severe cases such as hot spot faults. To ensure the safe operation of PV cells, their faults need to be detected in time. Thus, we developed a method to detect common faults that cause power loss in PV cells: partial shading, one hot spot, multiple hot spots, and abnormal aging. 50W and 56W single crystalline PV cells were selected as the experimental objects, and the I-V characteristics of the PV cells were measured under different temperatures, lights, and shadow shadings. The faults were detected using the Back Propagation neural network (BPNN) and Support Vector Machine (SVM). The fault of different power sizes of PV cells in different environments was detected using input parameters of the BP Neural Network. The BPNN showed an average accuracy of 97.1%. In the situation where partial shadows and a hot spot were prone to misclassification, the slope of the middle segment data in the I-V characteristics was input into SVM for training. The slope cut-off values were obtained and used as additional discriminatory conditions for two types of faults. The experimental results showed that the optimized system achieved an accuracy of 99.1%.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Classification Model of Chinese Classics Based on Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Traditional book management requires a framework and sorts books based on factors such as quantity and cost ratio which is a conventional sorting mode suitable for ordinary books. Although simple and applicable, traditional models do not scientifically reflect the demand, purchase time, supply level, and other aspects of classical Chinese culture works, making the classification relatively rough. Applying the partition theory of the support vector machine (SVM) to the ABC partition of classical Chinese cultural works, we constructed the partition model of classical Chinese cultural works. Actual data were used to compare the result of classification with that of conventional methods. The result proved the superiority of SVM and the automated classification of classical Chinese cultural works.

articleTitle: Design Mechanism of Intelligent Distribution Network Dispatching System Based on Situation awareness
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: The automatic input of the distribution network is not directly proportional to the output. Excessive input and output lead to a low utilization rate of the distribution network with repeated investment due to a lack of an appropriate scheduling system. Therefore, we proposed a scheduling system for the intelligent distribution network based on situation awareness by analyzing its design mechanism. The framework of the distribution network intelligent scheduling system was created based on situation awareness. The function design and system platform architecture design based on situation awareness were explored to introduce the function of the system. For the construction of the distribution network, data was collected for application analysis. Starting from its basic framework and core functions, the situation awareness map of the operating system in the distribution network was drawn to support the dispatching system of the distribution network.

articleTitle: Research on Bayesian Based Network Precision Computation Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Due to the booming development of e-commerce information, the number of website users has significantly increased. How to use user access traces on e-commerce platforms to conduct big data analysis of customer behavior and achieve precise product promotion has attracted much research interest in e-commerce. However, in the current research methods and technical means, there are many technical challenges, especially in the effectiveness of data analysis, information, image modeling, and data processing. Thus, it is necessary to analyze website customer attributes, behavioral characteristics, and browsing records using big data technology. In this study, Bayesian network models were used to explore customer behavioral characteristics and estimate the posterior probability of potential product generation or consumption behavior and usage behavior. The Bayesian network-based recommendation algorithm proposed in this study showed an accuracy of about 20% higher than traditional product recommendation models.

articleTitle: Multi-Trajectory Prediction of Pedestrian Based on Deep Neural Network Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Multimodal learning input has been used to predict the single trajectory of pedestrians. However, the single-trajectory is not efficient in making the vehicle avoid the sudden direction changes of the pedestrian in the drivable area. Therefore, we proposed a multi-trajectory prediction model with a Deep Neural Network (DNN) using an egocentric perspective. First, we input unimodal learning i.e., the historical trajectory sequences into the temporal encoder module. Second, the vision DNN-based network module was used to process the trajectory predictions through the temporal attention mechanism. Third, the linear projection was used for the decoder module to generate single- and multi-trajectory predictions for collision avoidance of vehicles and pedestrians. Finally, the proposed model outperformed previous state-of-the-art models in the experiments on publicly available Pedestrian Intention Estimation (PIE) and Joint Attention in Autonomous Driving (JAAD) datasets.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Classification of Writing Styles Based on KNN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Novels written by different writers have different literary characteristics, which are manifested in various aspects such as vocabulary, sentence structure, rhetorical techniques, and others. Classifying writing types and sentence characteristics helps identify writers. In the vector space modeling method, sentence classificationification was taken as the feature, and the mixed sentence analysis method was used to reduce the dimension of the sentence classificationification vector. The ITC algorithm weighed the attribute items, and the KNN algorithm was used to sort. Integrated judgment was made according to the writing style classifier. The function of the classifier turned out to have the potential for the improvement of sorting and identifying literary styles of Chinese modern and contemporary novelists.

articleTitle: Application of Geographic Information System Technology to Conduct Traffic Evaluation of Ancient City of Suzhou, China
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: One of the main tasks of urban regeneration is to determine the function and development intensity of the redevelopment of urban stock land. Renewal of the inappropriate traffic location disturbs the traffic and makes it difficult to increase the land value. Therefore, the spatial location and development intensity of the urban area need to be developed considering traffic capacity and demand. This enhances land value after development and promotes sustainable development and organic renewal. Application of Geographic Information System (GIS) coupling with the coordination pattern evaluation system was also required. For the evaluation of traffic supply and demand, the entropy weight method was used to measure three indexes: road network density, traffic accessibility, and traffic facility service level. Traffic capacity demand was measured by the amount of travel generated by different types of land uses. The coupling coordination model was used to evaluate the balance between the supply and demand of traffic capacity. According to the mixing degree and regulation law of land use, the optimal control of land use and the road was proposed to provide a basis for decision-making on the regeneration and construction of the ancient city.

articleTitle: Research on Human-Computer Interaction Collaborative Model of College English Learning Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: The knowledge system and learners in a human-computer interaction exhibit complex and dynamically evolving collaborative relationships. In this study, the elements of foreign language learners were integrated based on Hartson's four levels of generative mechanisms to investigate the ecological coupling of cognition behavior. Based on the present research, a human-machine interaction and collaboration model was constructed on language knowledge platforms.

articleTitle: Intelligent Evaluation Model for Role Transformation Ability of Vocational Teachers Based on Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: To optimize the effectiveness of training programs and enhance the teacher’s role and ransformation ability in higher vocational colleges, we developed an assessment model based on the backpropagation (BP) neural network. This model can be used for the systematic evaluation of the impact of training programs. Through extensive case analyses, we validated the efficacy of the evaluation model. The results demonstrated that the model effectively evaluated the effect of the teacher’s role and its transformation ability in training in higher vocational colleges. The evaluation model was highly feasible and practical and significantly improved the efficiency of evaluation compared to traditional algorithms. The model increased the efficiency by approximately 30% when compared to conventional methods.

articleTitle: Ensemble Recurrent Graph Neural Networks for Availability Prediction in Cellular Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: The self-organizing network mechanism based on machine learning technologies enhanced cell capabilities in the 5G RAN intelligent controller. In this paper, the cell availability prediction based on ensemble recurrent graph neural networks in cellular networks was proposed to optimize the QoS of mobile networks and improve the customer experience. Additionally, 5G RAN intelligent controller supported the self-healing network mechanism and followed the standard specifications of the open RAN architecture, 3GPP LTE key performance indicator, and Broadband Forum data model. In addition, the quality metrics, KPIs, and device logs were introduced into the learning model input factor for cell availability prediction. Experimental results show that the ensemble graph neural networks effectively predict cell availability better than traditional multilayer perceptron structure, and the learning model accuracy was more than 95%.

articleTitle: Research on Influencing Factors of Gear Lubrication of Automobile Wheel Reducer Based on Computer Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: The wheel reducer has a compact structure and high transmission power, and is widely used in new energy vehicles. However, it has a narrow space which limits lubrication. This also causes insufficient gear lubrication and poor heat dissipation, which influences the performance and service life of the wheel reducer. Therefore, it is important to find a way for the gear lubrication effectively. In this study, using computer simulation, the influencing factors of gear lubrication of an automobile wheel reducer were explored. The effect of gear speed and the degree of oil immersion on gear lubrication were also analyzed to lubricate the gear efficiently and improve the performance of the wheel reducer.

articleTitle: A Downlight Luminaire with High Luminous Efficacy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: A design method and manufacturing process of downlight luminaire with a truncated frusto-conical light shade is proposed in this article. The measurement results showed that the optimal illumination was 212.8 lux, and the luminaire exhibited 70% of the optimal illumination within an illumination range of 1.84 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. For normal- and warm-white light-emitting devices (LEDs), the optimal efficiencies of the proposed luminaires were 158 and 117 lm/W, respectively.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Controller Design for Table Tennis Robot to Hit Spinning Balls
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: A fuzzy controller was designed for a table tennis robot to strike a ball with topspin or backspin. First, the topspin or backspin was classified by comparing the difference between the binocular-vision-based measurement of a ball trajectory and the predicted trajectory using an ideal flying model. The striking signal, including the contact position and hitting time, of our table tennis robot can be estimated by inputting the trajectory features into a corresponding model. The face angle of a racket at the hitting moment was derived by a fuzzy inference system and was then used to control the robot. The average error of the contact position predicted by the proposed method was about 3 cm, and the average error of hitting timing was less than 13.5 ms. Experimental results verified the effectiveness of the proposed controller for striking spin balls.

articleTitle: Mental Health Simulation Model of Middle School Students Based on Fuzzy Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: In the simulation model of psychological quality, the correlation between the reverse psychological state and the impact of behavioral obstruction is determined based on the characteristics of middle school students’ reverse emotional phenomena. However, by misclassification in mapping tables based on the different types of psychological quality, the characteristics could not be accurately obtained, resulting in significant model deviation. Thus, a model for the simulation of the psychological quality of middle school students using the Fuzzy clustering algorithm. According to the structure of entropy, the psychological behavior process was sorted by the state of the middle object which did not meet the subjective needs. The average number of behavioral barriers formed at different levels of middle and adverse emotions was obtained, too. Then, the threshold of adverse emotions in behavioral orientation was calculated, and the correlation between adverse emotions and behavioral barriers of middle school students was obtained. The simulation result showed that the accuracy of this model was satisfactory, providing a strong theoretical basis for promoting the physical and mental health of and middle school students.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Enterprise AI Business Service System Based on NHibernate Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: To solve the problems of slow response time and monotonous page content in business service platforms, we designed a new system architecture of the artificial intelligence (AI) business service platform based on the model-view-controller (MVC) system and NHibernate technology. The original three-layer structure was refined to include a business logic layer, entity layer, user access connection layer, and user access layer. Data access and business logic were separated from each other to avoid coupling between layers and improve the practicality and maintainability of the system. System performance testing results showed that the platform had fast interactive response speed, low CPU and memory utilization, and improved performance by 48% compared to the original platform.

articleTitle: Feasibility Study on Enhancing User Experience of Smart Cinemas Using Internet of Things (IoT) Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: The feasibility of enhancing the user experience of smart cinemas was explored by using the Internet of Things (IoT) technology. As the audience expects better movie quality and service, traditional cinemas face the challenge of providing more personalized, comfortable, and interactive experiences. IoT technology, as an advanced smart solution, has been widely applied in various fields and has shown immense potential in the cinema industry. In this study, focusing on the feasibility, the application of IoT technology was investigated to the current user experience in smart cinemas. By employing IoT sensors, actuators, and cloud servers, smart cinema seats can be personalized based on individual settings stored in the cloud, thus meeting the specific needs of each audience member. The present research result on the feasibility of user data use indicated that the current level of user competence and the availability of IoT technology was supportive. IoT technology enhances the user experience of smart cinemas. With the application of innovative technologies, cinemas cater to audience demands with a more comfortable and personalized movie-watching experience and promote the sustainable development of the cinema business.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-based Classification of Mild Cognitive Impairment Using 1D and 2D Features of Audio Signals
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: We proposed the time-frequency deep neural networks (TF-DNN) to detect mild cognitive impairment (MCI) based on audio data. The collected audio data were used to build the TF-DNN for the picture description of 73 MCI patients and 31 healthy control (HC) or normal test subjects who were clinically diagnosed. For the features used in the TF-DNN, we applied time-domain and frequency-domain processing, where one-dimensional (1D) and two-dimensional (2D) features were extracted. The 1D audio features included the zero-crossing rate (ZCR), the spectral centroid (SC), and the spectral spread (SS), while the 2D feature included the audio spectrogram. Te performance analysis result showed an accuracy of 90% for the MCI classification using the TF-DNN.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Critical Care: A Smart Positive Pressure Based Non-Invasive Ventilator with Real-time IoT Health Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: A microcontroller-based ventilator was developed including a health monitoring system featuring a Wi-Fi-based notifier. A pressure-controlled ventilator was included, and an AMBU bag was used for controlling the breath length and pressure. In monitoring the system, Oxygen Saturation, body temperature, and Heart Beat rate were measured using specific modules. The measured data were shown on the display, and for critical conditions, the system alerted using Wi-Fi technology. The ventilator responded according to the data and changed the pressure of the Air Breather Bag using motors. A non-invasive ventilation mask was used for ventilating the patient’s lung and a manual control mechanism was used for emergency. There was an option for attaching an oxygen cylinder/concentrator. A battery was used to power the system.

articleTitle: Short-term Traffic Velocity Prediction Based on LSTM Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Accurate speed prediction of short-term traffic flow enhances the effectiveness of using traffic information in road sections and effectively alleviates traffic congestion pressure. It also assists decision-makers in travel planning. Recently, correlation algorithms based on deep learning have been widely used in time series prediction, especially in solving time series problems based on long short-term memory (LSTM) neural networks. Therefore, we proposed a traffic speed prediction model based on the convolutional neural network (CNN), stacked bidirectional LSTM (BiLSTM), and unidirectional LSTM neural network. CNN was used to extract the spatiotemporal information of traffic information. In BiLSTM, the spatiotemporal correlation of forward and backward time series was considered to traverse the input data twice. The result was superior to that of the conventional unidirectional LSTM. Traffic speed and the impact of stacking different numbers of LSTM networks were predicted, and hyperparameters were adjusted on the prediction results. The experiment result demonstrated that the suggested model improved prediction precision and the training time was shorter while verifying deeper stacked network structures.

articleTitle: Computer Simulation and Analysis of Pneumatic Noise of Supercharger Compressor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: To determine the main source and frequency distribution of the pneumatic noise of the supercharger compressor, the sound field characteristics of the compressor were studied using the broadband noise model and acoustic analogy method. The simulation results showed that the impeller was the main source of compressor aerodynamic noise, and the maximum compressor noise was generated at the impeller trailing edge. The impeller noise mainly occurred in the mid-frequency band. With the increase of harmonic frequency, the compressor sound power gradually decreased, and the sound power level reached the maximum at the first-order blade frequency. The aerodynamic noise of the compressor had obvious directivity at the nozzle of the compressor at the frequency of blade passage.

articleTitle: A Design of Network Based Platform for the Diagnosis of Beam-Type Structure
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Different from those existing schemes, in our previous work (presented in CACS 2022), a control area network (CAN) bus based network topology was proposed for structural health monitoring (SHM). A 154cm long beam-type steel structure was built up for experimental verification of the proposed diagnosis platform. Instead of the results from the axial vibration data only, in this paper we extend the previous study to cover the planar effect on the testing beam. The whole area of the proposed testing beam is divided into three regions. Nine sets of the designed vibration module formed as a 3 by 3 mesh are set up on each region for vibration testing. It is observed from the experimental data that the frequency spectra of the data collected by nine sets of sensor module on the same region are almost identical for each different testing. Case studies of the testing beam by placing sensing modules on three different regions are also set up to verify the validity of the designed platform, which demonstrate the success of the proposed design.

articleTitle: Evaluating Freeform Creativity versus Goal-Directed Exercises in VR: An Examination of Immersion Levels and Effectiveness
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: As virtual reality (VR) continues to evolve, the study on user interaction within the VR environment becomes increasingly important. Thus, we investigated two interactions "Exploration and Browsing" and "Purpose and Guidance," using VR platforms to compare immersion levels and exercise effectiveness. We analyzed the results from 33 participants using Gravity Sketch 3D for freeform creativity, and Unity3D generated program for goal-directed exercises. We assessed four factors of 'concentration,' 'enjoyment,' 'sense of time distortion,' and 'control' for immersion levels and self-recognized exercise intensity, and participants' preference between the two VR formats. Preliminary results indicated that Freeform Creativity scored high overall in Immersion Levels and Exercise Effectiveness compared to Goal-Directed Exercises. The data also suggested that when participants used creative VR tools for exploration and browsing, stronger Immersion Levels were triggered, which in turn, led to more exercise. However, providing participants with exercise goals did not guarantee a higher level of exercise.

articleTitle: A Risk Prediction Model for Network Security Using Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: To reduce the probability of network risk, a knowledge graph-driven risk prediction model for network security was developed by exploring the information on network detection data. Indicators of the model were determined for security protection capability, attack threat risk, network performance anomaly index, and disaster tolerance, which were included in the index system of the developed model. The primary and secondary indicators were categorized to construct the knowledge graph. The graph attention mechanism was also integrated into the model. The entity-level attention network layer learned the attention coefficients among neighboring entities in the relationship path. The relationship of level attention network layers was obtained using new entity feature vectors and the attention coefficients. Entity feature vectors were aggregated to output risk prediction results. The experimental results showed that the model accurately predicted the level of risk in network security, reducing the number of risk events to more than 38%.

articleTitle: State Estimation Predictor with Stochastic time-delay Based Framework for Teleoperated Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: The recent automotive industry has consistently focused on autonomous driving technologies for their potential chances to free human drivers from tedious maneuvering labor. Although commercialized full-driving automation vehicles are thought to be capable of replacing human drivers, many disengagement reports of autonomous driving are doubtful about its safety-integrity levels to fulfill the acceptable minimum risk. As a countermeasure and backup plan for the disengagement of autonomous driving, recent approaches have focused on the teleoperation method in which humans and vehicles collaborate. However, the performance of the teleoperation method largely relies on the communication quality between the control center and the vehicle. Due to this fact, the communication delay has to be preliminarily investigated and profiled to be used as a boundary to classify as a communication outlier. Therefore, we developed a real-time communication delay classification scheme using a state estimation predictor with a stochastic time-delay-based Framework. The proposed framework was tested with an actual human-vehicle interface using a lte/5G network with a global navigation satellite (GNSS) system. The communication delay was classified according to the level of the potential risk considering the magnitude of the communication delay. The result showed that the total amount of the communication delay was compensated by considering the communication time delay.

articleTitle: Application of Multi-dimensional Decision Tree Model on Chinese Tourists' Willingness to Travel Abroad in the Post-pandemic Era
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: From the perspective of tourists, we conducted an empirical analysis of Chinese residents' willingness to travel abroad in the post-pandemic era. Taking residents in Fuzhou, a coastal city in Fujian province, as the research object, a multi-dimensional interactive decision tree model was used to clarify the differences in perception of outbound tourism among different groups in China. Their perceived willingness was cross-detected to distinguish the factors affecting the willingness to travel abroad on multiple interactive scales. The results showed that different groups of people had different responses to outbound travel willingness. The willingness to travel abroad was not strong and more people postponed or turned to domestic travel. Based on this, it was proposed to adopt a combination of means such as new media marketing, festival marketing, joint marketing, emotional marketing, and low-price strategy for the cost-effectiveness of international tourism. It is necessary to improve the quality of outbound tourism services, eliminate the anxiety of outbound tourists, and stimulate the recovery of the international tourism market.

articleTitle: Motion Footprint Recognition and Simulation of Aerobics Players Based on Bayesian Software Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: The traditional algorithm of aerobics athlete's moving recognition collected the edge feature detection points using the threshold segmentation method of footprint recognition. However, efficiency was too low to be applied in practice. A Bayesian algorithm was developed in this study for recognizing athlete footprints in aerobics competitions. The contour range of athlete footprints was extracted, and the depth domain of the footprints was divided into several non-overlapping small modules. The expectation-maximization (EM) algorithm was used to cluster and analyze the feature functions to obtain the imaging features of athlete footprints during competition. The experimental results showed that the algorithm had high accuracy of over 90% in athlete footprint image recognition, showing satisfactory identity recognition.

articleTitle: Synergistic Similarity Graph Construction (SSGC) for Steel Plate Fault Diagnosis with Graph Attention Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Fault diagnosis in industrial production is vital as emerging technologies require innovative methods to identify subtle fault distinctions. Traditional machine learning approaches for steel plate fault classification inadequately exploit sample relationships, limiting accurate diagnosis. Thus, we proposed to use graph construction methods in conjunction with Graph Attention Networks (GAT) for steel plate fault classification. We introduced the following four techniques to generate adjacency matrices representing sample connections: k-nearest Neighbors (k-NN), threshold-based cosine similarity, threshold-based Mahalanobis distance, and Minimum Spanning Tree (MST), Additionally, we proposed a novel graph construction algorithm, Synergistic Similarity Graph Construction (SSGC), to fuse these adjacency matrices, leveraging the strengths of each technique. We evaluated the proposed techniques on the UCI Steel Plates Faults dataset, comparing them with traditional machine learning models. The results demonstrated that the combination of GAT and SSGC leads to superior performance over the best traditional machine learning models, improving the accuracy, precision, recall, and Macro-F1 scores by 4.8, 4.8, 4.6, and 4.7%, respectively. In conclusion, The proposed method is a novel approach for steel plate fault classification using GAT and effective graph construction techniques. The method expands Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) applicability to tabular datasets without explicit connections, enhancing fault classification performance in industrial production. This research showed how to use GNNs in fault diagnosis across diverse domains. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/AnguoCYF/SSGC

articleTitle: Self-supervised Learning for Drug Synergy Prediction with Small Data Set
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Drug combination is a promising approach to enhance treatment effectiveness and mitigate the adverse effects associated with individual drugs. However, the substantial number of possible combinations and the time-intensive nature of cell response testing present formidable challenges. To overcome these challenges, deep learning techniques have been employed to effectively process complex data. Nevertheless, the reliance of deep learning models on extensive labeled medical data poses significant barriers. To overcome this limitation, the utilization of unlabeled data has emerged as a viable alternative. Therefore, we investigated the application of self-supervised learning to capture the molecular structures of drugs in conjunction with transfer learning, to predict the synergistic effects resulting from drug combinations on various types of cancer cells. It is assumed that the integration of self-supervised learning techniques enhances the predictive performance concerning the synergistic effects exhibited by drug pairs. The experiments were conducted by tuning parameters, including token size (i.e., 1, 3, 5, 10, and 37) and model architecture (i.e., Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), and Convolutional LSTM) with the self-supervised learning process. Additionally, we examined the influence of training data size (ranging from 100 to 5% of the total data) and model architecture (CNN, LSTM, and Convolutional LSTM) on drug synergy prediction. The findings demonstrated that, among the self-supervised learning parameters, the Convolutional LSTM model with a token size of 37 showed the highest accuracy of 83.07%. Furthermore, with the knowledge of chemical structures acquired by self-supervised learning, the self-supervised learning technique reduced the mean square error (MSE) by 0.32−4.22% without the self-supervised process.

articleTitle: Recommending Fastest Path to Commuters by Using Shared Vehicles and Public Transportation Systems under Time-Dependent Road Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Shared vehicles and public transportation can be combined to provide a more efficient and convenient way to travel in urban areas. Nevertheless, existing literature lacks systematic discussions on optimizing routes by integrating shared-use vehicles with public transportation within a limited time and cost constraints. Meanwhile, the optimal route varies depending on the time of day and the availability of shared-use vehicles. Thus, we narrowed the gap by investigating fast route planning by integrating shared-use vehicles and public transportation in a time-dependent network. Three different algorithms were proposed for route planning on time-dependent road networks. The Basic Route Planning Algorithm (BPRA) is used to find the best solution by exhaustively searching all possible routes. It is the most accurate algorithm but time-consuming. Then, the Advanced Pruning Algorithm (APA), based on BPRA, was proposed using a pruning technique to reduce the number of possible routes. Indexing processing makes APA more efficient than BPRA, but it needs to be more accurate. Therefore, we adopted a grid index in the Grid Index Algorithm (GIA) to store the road network. GIA quickly finds the shortest path between two locations using grid indexing. GIA is the most efficient algorithm with less accuracy than BPRA or APA. The choice of algorithms depends on the application's specific requirements. If accuracy is the most critical factor, then BPRA must be used. If efficiency is the most crucial factor, then GIA must be used. APA is a compromise between accuracy and efficiency. We validated the effectiveness of the above three methods with different-oriented experiments.

articleTitle: Predicting Blood Glucose Levels with Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: We explored the effectiveness of machine learning algorithms in predicting blood glucose levels based on various input features, including demographic data, lifestyle factors, and physiological measurements using a dataset obtained from the OhioT1DM database. In particular, the dataset comprises data from 12 individuals with type 1 diabetes, spanning the years 2018 and 2020. The data for each individual is a comprehensive set of 22 features collected from devices, wearable sensors, and self-reports, capturing various lifestyle, and physiological aspects such as eating dairy, steps, heart rate, skin temperature, air temperature, and galvanic skin response (GSR). Machine learning algorithms, including Long short-term memory (LSTM) and Support Vector Regression (SVR) models, with historical data from 5, 10, 15, and 20 steps were employed to develop models to predict blood glucose levels at 30 and 60 minutes ahead. The accuracy of the predicted horizons was evaluated using three metrics, namely, MAE, MAPE, and RMSE to compare the performance of LSTM and SVR for each patient ID. To train and test the predictive models, the data for each individual in the dataset was split into training and testing sets. This approach ensured that the model learned from one individual's data and was evaluated on unseen data from the same individual. This individual-based training and testing procedure allowed for personalized predictions and accounts for inter-individual variations in diabetes management. The experimental results indicated that SVR performed better for the 30-min prediction, while LSTM performed better for the 60-min prediction. Among the patient IDs, ID596 achieved the best prediction results in terms of MAE, and RMSE, with values of 10.41 mg/dl MAE and 15.15 mg/dl RMSE at the 30-min prediction, and 18.26 mg/dl MAE, and 24.99 mg/dl RMSE at the 60-min prediction. Additionally, ID570 achieved the best prediction results in terms of MAPE, with values of 7.2% at the 30-min, and 13.3% at the 60-min prediction.

articleTitle: Recipe Verification Based on Age-Adjusted Multiple Servings by JavaScript and R Language
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Access to nutritious and healthy diets is crucial for children's health, growth, and development. The school meal programs play an integral role in ensuring that all children, regardless of their socio-economic background can receive high-quality and nutritious food. The primary goal of these programs is to reduce the occurrence of undernutrition, overweight, and obesity as well as to promote healthy diets. Although an extensive number of verified recipes are made available to help schools prepare healthy meals, many schools still prefer to use their recipes to make school meals. Unfortunately, most school-own recipes have not been verified, and therefore is difficult to guarantee the nutritional quality and outcome of recipes. In this paper, we presented a systematic approach to verify and correct the recipes using a combination of statistics and text analysis. The proposed method incorporated the age and number of servings to facilitate and improve the process of verification and correction of recipes. A total number of 7,505 school lunch recipes were used in the study. In particular, the dataset of 1,009 verified standardized recipes was trained using the proposed model to evaluate and revise the set of 6,496 unverified test data. The experimental results demonstrated the effectiveness and benefits of the proposed method for verifying the recipes. The results further illustrated that the presented approach suggested the revision of the invalid recipes.

articleTitle: Automatic Mathematical Word Problem Solver Based on Goal-Driven Tree Network Structure and Multi-Head Attention Improvement
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: The design of solvers for automatically solving mathematical problems has been used widely in artificial intelligence (AI) applications for education. Deep learning (DL) methods are mainly used to design solvers. However, most methods ignore the importance of data preprocessing and lack the judgment of the importance of numbers for constructing correct solutions. For this reason, we used FoolNLTK, a tool with higher word segmentation accuracy, and ELMo, a word embedding method, in data preprocessing to enhance the performance of the mathematical problem solver in data preprocessing. To capture longer-distance dependencies and obtain better semantic weight assignment results, we changed the single-head attention in the GTS model to multi-head attention. Based on the above improvements, we built a dataset Math-AP to verify the applicability of the improved model. We named the model Seq-GTS. Experiment results showed that the model improved accuracy significantly compared to the GTS model.

articleTitle: An Integrated Approach for Product Development using Latent Dirichlet Allocation and Gradient Boosting Decision Tree Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic brought immense strain on global manufacturing, highlighting the critical importance of the Customer-to-Manufacturer (C2M) model. To effectively manage customer needs and support decision-making in product development, there is a need for active research and the provision of additional tools. Thus, we collected and analyzed online sales data and user reviews to offer real-time insights into consumer needs. By using this data-driven recommendation system, product development directions can be identified to understand market demands, reduce the time required for research and development, and enhance overall product innovation efficiency. We also explored the effectiveness of employing the Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) method and various machine learning technologies for predicting Amazon consumer ratings. Through the integration of structured and unstructured data, valuable industry insights were obtained, enabling businesses to understand consumer needs, discover market opportunities, and refine product specifications. Embracing the C2M model and incorporating consumer perspectives into decision-making processes were essential for sustainable business growth in the current economic landscape.

articleTitle: An Environment Control Management System for Container-Type Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: The most widely used energy storage system in current industrial applications and commercialization is Battery Energy Storage System (BESS). Due to its fast response capability, BESS has been accepted as an energy storage system worldwide. However, there are still high risks associated with large-scale BESS installations. System malfunctions can lead to battery damage, and inadequate environmental control of BESS operation can result in incidents such as battery leakage, flooding, or prolonged exposure to high temperatures. To prevent disasters and proactively prepare for them, we proposed the planning and design of an Environmental Control System (ECS) for BESS. The ECS adopted sensors to monitor the BESS site and the batteries, preparing for potential disasters. It continuously collected environmental monitoring data and was integrated with a Battery Management and Monitoring System (MBMS) to protect the internal batteries and prevent the spread of disasters. The experiment was conducted in an actual BESS installation, and Modbus communication protocol was used for the communication of sensors and the management system. The experimental results demonstrated that this planned ECS maintained the temperature within the working range for the batteries inside the container, and the relevant components designed for the system effectively interacted with the MBMS to protect the energy storage system.

articleTitle: A Novel Bio-Inspired Hierarchical Corrugated Tube To Enhance Crashworthiness Performance
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Bio-inspired multi-cell, multi-corner structures have been widely used to enhance the energy absorption capability of thin-walled structures due to outstanding energy dissipation and stable collapse. However, with the increase in loading and safety in energy-absorbing devices, further improvement of the crashworthiness performance of these structures is needed. Therefore, a novel type of bio-inspired hierarchical corrugated tubes (BHCTs) was proposed in this study, inspired by hierarchical structure in the impact region of the dactyl clubs from an Odontodactylus scyllarus– Peacock mantis shrimp. A mathematic sinewave equation was established to control the corrugated patterns in the cross-section, and the crash performance under a quasi-static axial load complies with ASTM D695 standard of different hierarchical configurations was designed and analyzed using finite element analysis in ABAQUS/Explicit environment. The effect of geometrical parameters was also investigated. Entropy-based Technique for Order of Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution (TOPSIS) was employed to identify the optimal structure for the best energy absorption capacity. Finally, the optimal structure was fabricated using Acrylonitrile Butadiene Styrene (ABS) material through the Fused Deposition Modeling technique in 3D printing and tested experimentally. The findings showed that the deviation between numerical and experimental analysis was acceptable, implying the numerical analysis was reliable. The crashworthiness performance of the BHCTs was significantly superior to that of the conventional multi-cell square tube. In conclusion, the result of this study provides a reference framework for designing and investigating bio-inspired hierarchical corrugated tubes for energy-absorbing applications. The novel structure was proposed for energy-absorbing, impact-resistant devices.

articleTitle: Research on Zhuang's Speech-to-Text and Translation Cloud Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: The Zhuang people distribute in Guangxi province maintaining their language without characters. To convert the speech of the Zhuang into Chinese characters and translate it into other languages, we built a database to construct an end-to-end automatic speech recognition using a neural network SaformerNet. The network used a transformer-based deep learning model for the translation. An edge computing-based private cloud system using FPGA acceleration was proposed for the rapid response of the network. The results demonstrated that the proposed solution was suitable for small-scale conversion of natural languages in a real-time application.

articleTitle: Wireless Monitoring of Gearbox Vibrations with Embedded Sensors Using LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: The development of sensor monitoring systems for rotating machinery is important in automating industrial machine monitoring. Traditionally, the primary method for monitoring rotating machinery involved wired sensors such as accelerometers that were attached to the housing of the component under operation. However, this approach has a limitation since it cannot capture vibrations from the rotating part underneath the housing. Vibration measurements are crucial for machine health monitoring and analysis. Wireless vibration monitoring offers many benefits over wired monitoring. Thus, we implemented a wireless monitoring system using an embedded system design as a reliable option. A wireless monitoring system based on MEMS accelerometers with 3-axis digital outputs was used to measure vibrations ranging from -10 g to 10 g and temperature in a range from 0 to +70 °C. The system used the IEEE 802.11 wireless communication protocol and ESP modules. All the sensors were connected to a microcontroller and integrated into a printed circuit board, and the signals, data logging, and alarms were integrated into a PC platform using National Instruments LabVIEW software. The proposed monitoring system was embedded in a planetary gearbox to test its capabilities. The experimental results showed that the proposed wireless monitoring system could monitor gearbox vibrations in real-time, rendering data in the time domain, frequency domain, and root mean square. The data log files were used for vibration analysis. The research result verified the reliability and effectiveness of the wireless monitoring system by analyzing and diagnosing the vibration measurement signals.

articleTitle: Metaverse: A Bibliometric Analysis by Internet Crawler and Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Digital platforms have been widely adopted during Covid19 pandemic, but individuals and organizations have encountered various challenges with these digital platforms. Metaverse is a new Internet evolution that addresses the challenges of supporting humans in seamlessly moving between digital spaces and the physical world. Many bibliometric studies have been published on Metaverse, but previous findings on this topic are inconsistent and contradictory. Therefore, we explored trends in Metaverse research through bibliometric analysis. An online search was conducted on 16 February 2023. A total of 706 journal documents were obtained from the Scopus database. The results revealed that China was the most productive country with three China productive institutions, two China productive authors, and four China funding sponsors. This bibliometric analysis results confirmed that the rate of Metaverse research has sharply increased. The top nine most cited documents were classified as secondary research. Taking a socio-technical design approach, the Metaverse research areas identified by these review articles can be grouped into four main levels of computing: mechanical, informational, psychological, and social. The limitations of this bibliometric study were also identified.

articleTitle: An Improved Unsupervised Semantic Segmentation Algorithm Based on CycleGAN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Due to advancements in computer vision, semantic segmentation models are applied for facial recognition on the road. Conventional models require a substantial data set. We introduced an enhanced algorithm based on a cyclic generative adversarial neural network. For facial recognition. In contrast to traditional models, this algorithm eliminated the need for extensive paired datasets and avoided labor-intensive pixel-level annotation, thereby significantly saving time and costs and allowing rapid semantic segmentation application. Initially, deep separable convolutions were downsampled to reduce model parameters. Subsequently, an attention mechanism was used in the generator based on comparative experiments, enhancing information selection. To address edge blurriness in the cyclic generative adversarial network, a third set of artificially blurred datasets was introduced into the discriminator to optimize the generator's output images. Finally, the Smooth L1 loss computing model was used with reduced gradients at low errors to reduce outliers and enhance network robustness. Experimental results showed algorithmic improvements on the original network, maintaining a stable generation of high-quality semantic segmentation images.

articleTitle: Automated Test Input Generation for Testing Representational State Transfer (REST) Application Programming Interface (API) using Parameter Fuzzing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Fuzz testing has been widely used for generating inputs automatically to test the stability and security of RESTful web services. To be effective, fuzzing input generation needs to provide both valid and invalid input data. One way to automatically generate fuzzy inputs to test Representational State Transfer (REST) Application Programming Interface (API) is based on the data types and structures of the API parameters. However, even with such information, it is still challenging to automatically generate effective fuzzy inputs. Thus, we proposed a method to generate fuzzy inputs for API parameters according to their categories instead of generating the inputs randomly. An API parameter was classified into a corresponding category according to the parameter’s information first. Based on the classified category, associated rules were used to generate fuzzy inputs for the parameter automatically. The proposed method has been implemented and integrated into RESTler, a well-known open-source fuzzing tool for REST APIs. Experimental results showed that, as compared with random input generation, the proposed method had wider API status code coverage and better error detection results.

articleTitle: Impact of Modulated Routing Mechanism on Wireless Sensor Network Systems: A Comprehensive Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) have been hugely advanced in recent years, driven by the growth of equipment types and numbers and the reduction of cost. Various services have been provided based on application requirements and network services. Among the energy-saving solutions in WSN environments, the Low Energy Adaptive Clustering Hierarchy (LEACH) mechanism stands out. This hierarchical protocol makes cluster heads aggregate and switches data sent by the cluster entity nodes toward a fixed Sink node. In this study, we proposed Cost Balanced LEACH (CBLEACH), a novel set of routing mechanisms that introduce the mobility aspect to the Sink node (SN) and balances the decision of cluster head (CH) election by considering the distances between nodes and the residual energy of expected CH candidates. CB-LEACH allows nodes to be close to the SN to transmit data directly, ensuring non-collapsing energy and achieving the greatest efficiency in the WSN. The functionalities and features of the CB-LEACH routing mechanism were explored to provide valuable insights for researchers and practitioners in WSNs. We introduced a balance factor variable that merged the two impacting and time-dependent properties of nodes: distance and energy. The CH election in each cluster was based on a cost rule derived from a linear Eq. of the balance factor. We presented four different modulation schemes for the balance factor, each with its own rule, and analyzed their impact on the CB-LEACH mechanism. We examined the system's functionalities and compared the lifetime and transmitted number of frames in different scenarios involving the epoch number, the speed of SN, and various systems including Direct Sequence, basic LEACH, enhanced LEACH with mobile SN, and CB-LEACH. The findings in this study demonstrated that the modulated CB-LEACH routing mechanism outperformed other routing cases, offering superior features and capabilities to the WSNs.

articleTitle: Analysis of Walking Trajectories and Physical Fitness Using Machine Learning To Identify Mild Cognitive Impairment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: With the aging of the global population, the proportion of patients with dementia has increased. The current method for diagnosing and evaluating mild cognitive impairment (MCI) involves an assessment and blood examinations. Clinically, a question-and-answer test between psychologists and patients is used as the basis for diagnosing MCI. However, this method is subjective. Research results have indicated that patients’ gait or posture balance can be used as an index for the early diagnosis of MCI. Therefore, we tested the gait behavior and physical fitness of 66 people aged over 65 years. The average age of the participants in this study was 73.2 ± 5.66 years. Of these participants, 33 had MCI, and 33 did not. The characteristic parameters of the participants’ walking trajectories were captured using a self-developed system by using image analysis to track and record the coordinates of a patient’s trajectory. The trajectory parameters of the patient were calculated, then. A total of 28 trajectory parameters were obtained from seven physical fitness tests, and these parameters were screened using the Montreal Cognitive Assessment scale to select the parameters with high discrimination ability for MCI. Moreover, the classification results obtained using multiple machine learning models were analyzed and compared to determine the optimal model for evaluating MCI. The results indicated that the classification accuracy was higher when physical fitness parameters and walking trajectory parameters were used in the adopted models than when only physical fitness parameters were used. In the classification with physical fitness parameters, Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) and decision tree showed the highest accuracy (84.76%) among the adopted models. The duration of stay of an individual in a straight region and physical fitness parameters had high discrimination ability.

articleTitle: Large-scale Air Purifier System with Intelligent Sensor Frequency Conversion Control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Knowledge Innovation and Invention (ICKII)
abstract: Due to the increasing air pollution and its harm to the environment caused by industrial activities, daily life and people’s health are threatened seriously. The air cleaner is used to purify air at home. With increasing awareness of environmental problems, people pay attention to the prevention and treatment of air pollution in large-scale indoor areas such as shopping malls, department stores, hospitals, and factories, However, there are few large-sized air cleaners, and they are only used to purify air not monitoring and controlling the parameters of environmental pollution. We proposed an intelligent sensing control technology for air cleaners that can be used in a large area. By detecting the air quality using an NH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> sensor, H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>S sensor, and total volatile organic compounds (TVOC) sensor, the proposed air cleaner was used to increase the air delivery rate by controlling the speed motor with an inverter. In large indoor areas, a dual-port multi-wing blower motor was used to increase the air exchange capacity of the air cleaner. A touch screen was employed to allow for the intuitive controls of the air cleaner. Three control modes such as automatic, manual, and timer modes were provided according to the user's needs. Experiment results showed that the proposed air cleaner effectively filtered dust and removed chemical gases, odors, bacteria, and other pollutants, which led to preventing indoor air pollution.
